test_cases.title: Start of Mission tetikleyicisiyle iletişim oturumu başlatma
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, Start of Mission moduna geçmeye hazır durumdadır. RBC iletişim bilgileri saklanmıştır.
test_cases.test_inputs: Start of Mission komutu.

steps.action: Sürücü Start of Mission işlemini başlatır.
steps.expected: OBU, RBC ile iletişim oturumu kurmak için güvenli radyo bağlantısı kurulum isteğini gönderir.

steps.action: RBC'den sistem sürümü yanıtı alınır.
steps.expected: OBU, oturumun kurulduğunu kabul eder ve sürücüye oturum kurulduğunu bildirir.

test_cases.title: Rota kenarı komutu ile iletişim oturumu başlatma
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, aktif bir iletişim oturumu olmadan çalışmaktadır.
test_cases.test_inputs: Rota kenarından gelen 'İletişim oturumu kur' komutu.

steps.action: Rota kenarı, OBU'ya iletişim oturumu kurma komutu gönderir.
steps.expected: OBU, komutu alır ve RBC ile iletişim oturumu kurma sürecini başlatır.

steps.action: RBC'den sistem sürümü yanıtı alınır.
steps.expected: OBU, oturumun kurulduğunu kabul eder.

test_cases.title: Güvenli radyo bağlantısı kurulumunda tekrar deneme
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, iletişim oturumu başlatma tetikleyicisi almıştır.
test_cases.test_inputs: İlk denemede radyo bağlantısı başarısız, ikinci denemede başarılı.

steps.action: OBU, güvenli radyo bağlantısı kurulum isteğini gönderir.
steps.expected: Bağlantı kurulamaz, hata durumu oluşur.

steps.action: OBU, isteği hemen tekrarlar.
steps.expected: Güvenli radyo bağlantısı kurulur.

steps.action: OBU, 'İletişim oturumu başlatma' mesajını gönderir.
steps.expected: RBC'den sistem sürümü yanıtı alınır.

steps.action: Sistem sürümü uyumlu olduğunda OBU'nun tepkisi gözlemlenir.
steps.expected: OBU, oturumun kurulduğunu kabul eder ve 'Oturum kuruldu' raporunu gönderir.

test_cases.title: Uyumlu olmayan sistem sürümü durumunda oturum sonlandırma
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, güvenli radyo bağlantısını kurmuştur.
test_cases.test_inputs: RBC'den gelen uyumsuz sistem sürümü bilgisi.

steps.action: OBU, 'İletişim oturumu başlatma' mesajını gönderir.
steps.expected: RBC'den sistem sürümü yanıtı alınır.

steps.action: Sistem sürümü uyumsuz olduğunda OBU'nun tepkisi gözlemlenir.
steps.expected: OBU, 'Uyumlu sürüm desteklenmiyor' mesajını gönderir.

steps.action: Sürücü arayüzü kontrol edilir.
steps.expected: Sürücüye uyumsuzluk hatası bildirilir.

steps.action: Oturum durumu kontrol edilir.
steps.expected: İletişim oturumu sonlandırılır.

test_cases.title: Rota kenarı komutuna göre radyo sistemi seçimi
test_cases.preconditions: OBU'da hem GSM-R hem FRMCS radyo sistemleri mevcuttur. Rota kenarı, FRMCS-only RBC'ye bağılmak için komut gönderir.
test_cases.test_inputs: Rota kenarı komutu: FRMCS-only RBC hedefi.

steps.action: Rota kenarı, FRMCS-only RBC'ye iletişim oturumu kurma komutu gönderir.
steps.expected: OBU, öncelik sırasına göre FRMCS radyo sistemini seçer.

steps.action: Güvenli radyo bağlantısı kurulum isteği gönderilir.
steps.expected: İstek FRMCS üzerinden iletilir.

test_cases.title: Başarılı radyo sisteminin hafızaya kaydedilmesi
test_cases.preconditions: OBU'da hem GSM-R hem FRMCS radyo sistemleri mevcuttur. Önceki oturum GSM-R ile kurulmuştur.
test_cases.test_inputs: Yeni iletişim oturumu başlatma tetikleyicisi.

steps.action: Yeni bir iletişim oturumu başlatılır ve FRMCS ile başarılı bir şekilde kurulur.
steps.expected: OBU, FRMCS radyo sistemini kullandığını hafızaya kaydeder.

steps.action: OBU'nun hafıza kaydı kontrol edilir.
steps.expected: Son başarılı radyo sistemi olarak FRMCS görülmektedir.

test_cases.title: Oturum kurulumu sırasında End of Mission ile iptal
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, iletişim oturumu kurma sürecindedir (güvenli radyo bağlantısı kuruldu, sistem sürümü bekleniyor).
test_cases.test_inputs: End of Mission komutu.

steps.action: Oturum kurulumu sırasında End of Mission komutu verilir.
steps.expected: OBU, oturum kurulumunu iptal eder.

steps.action: Güvenli radyo bağlantısı durumu kontrol edilir.
steps.expected: Güvenli radyo bağlantısı serbest bırakılır.

test_cases.title: Son bilinen RBC kimliği ile rota kenarı komutu
test_cases.preconditions: OBU'da RBC iletişim bilgileri saklanmıştır. Rota kenarı, 'son bilinen RBC' kimliği ile komut gönderir.
test_cases.test_inputs: Rota kenarı komutu: 'Son bilinen RBC' kimliği ve farklı bir telefon numarası.

steps.action: Rota kenarı, 'son bilinen RBC' kimliği ve farklı bir telefon numarası ile iletişim oturumu kurma komutu gönderir.
steps.expected: OBU, komuttaki telefon numarasını yok sayar.

steps.action: OBU'nun RBC'ye bağlanma denemesi gözlemlenir.
steps.expected: OBU, saklanan RBC iletişim bilgilerini kullanarak RBC'ye bağlanır.

test_cases.title: Saklanan RBC bilgisi yokken 'son bilinen RBC' komutunun yok sayılması
test_cases.preconditions: OBU'da RBC iletişim bilgileri saklanmamıştır.
test_cases.test_inputs: Rota kenarı komutu: 'Son bilinen RBC' kimliği.

steps.action: Rota kenarı, 'son bilinen RBC' kimliği ile iletişim oturumu kurma komutu gönderir.
steps.expected: OBU, komutu yok sayar.

steps.action: OBU'nun RBC'ye bağlanma denemesi gözlemlenir.
steps.expected: OBU, RBC'ye bağlanma denemesi yapmaz.

test_cases.title: Ongoing session prevents new session establishment with same RBC
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2 mode. A communication session with RBC-A is currently being established (state: Establishing).
test_cases.test_inputs: Trigger for Start of Mission in Level 2.
test_cases.assumptions: RBC-A is the target RBC for the Start of Mission.

steps.action: Initiate Start of Mission in Level 2 targeting RBC-A.
steps.expected: The OBU does not initiate a new communication session establishment procedure with RBC-A. The existing establishment process continues.

steps.action: Wait for the initial session establishment with RBC-A to complete.
steps.expected: The session with RBC-A is established successfully.

test_cases.title: Established session without termination prevents new session with same RBC
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2 mode. A communication session with RBC-A is established and active. No 'Termination of Communication Session' message has been sent to RBC-A.
test_cases.test_inputs: Manual selection of RBC contact information for RBC-A by the driver.
test_cases.assumptions: The driver manually selects RBC-A again while the session is active.

steps.action: Driver manually selects RBC-A contact information outside of Start of Mission.
steps.expected: The OBU does not attempt to open a further communication session with RBC-A. The existing session remains active.

test_cases.title: Termination of existing session when establishing new session with different RBC
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2 mode. An active communication session exists with RBC-A. The OBU is capable of handling multiple sessions (or the exception condition is not met).
test_cases.test_inputs: Order from trackside to establish a session with RBC-B.
test_cases.assumptions: RBC-B is a different RBC than RBC-A.

steps.action: Receive an order from trackside to establish a communication session with RBC-B.
steps.expected: The OBU initiates the termination of the existing session with RBC-A.

steps.action: Wait for the termination of the session with RBC-A to complete.
steps.expected: The session with RBC-A is terminated.

steps.action: Observe the OBU's action towards RBC-B.
steps.expected: The OBU establishes a new communication session with RBC-B.

test_cases.title: Exception: RBC transition order does not terminate current session if multi-session capable
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2 mode. An active communication session exists with RBC-A (currently supervising). The OBU is capable of handling more than one communication session through GSM-R.
test_cases.test_inputs: RBC transition order containing an embedded order to establish a session with Accepting RBC-B.
test_cases.assumptions: RBC-B is the Accepting RBC in the transition.

steps.action: Receive an RBC transition order from RBC-A that includes an embedded order to establish a session with RBC-B.
steps.expected: The OBU does not terminate the existing session with RBC-A.

steps.action: Observe the OBU's action towards RBC-B.
steps.expected: The OBU establishes a new communication session with RBC-B while maintaining the session with RBC-A.

test_cases.title: Exception: RBC transition order terminates current session if single-session only
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2 mode. An active communication session exists with RBC-A (currently supervising). The OBU can handle only one communication session through GSM-R.
test_cases.test_inputs: RBC transition order containing an embedded order to establish a session with Accepting RBC-B.
test_cases.assumptions: RBC-B is the Accepting RBC in the transition.

steps.action: Receive an RBC transition order from RBC-A that includes an embedded order to establish a session with RBC-B.
steps.expected: The OBU terminates the existing session with RBC-A.

steps.action: Observe the OBU's action towards RBC-B.
steps.expected: The OBU establishes a new communication session with RBC-B.

test_cases.title: Evaluation of balise information in Sleeping mode (Nominal direction)
test_cases.preconditions: Engine is in Sleeping (SL) mode. Train orientation is Nominal. A balise group is crossed in the Nominal direction.
test_cases.test_inputs: Balise group data containing: 1) Speed restriction valid for Nominal direction, 2) Speed restriction valid for Reverse direction, 3) Speed restriction valid for Both directions.
test_cases.assumptions: The balise group is crossed in the Nominal direction.

steps.action: Cross the balise group in the Nominal direction while in SL mode.
steps.expected: The OBU takes into account the speed restriction valid for the Nominal direction.

steps.action: Check the status of the speed restriction valid for the Reverse direction.
steps.expected: The OBU ignores the speed restriction valid only for the Reverse direction.

steps.action: Check the status of the speed restriction valid for Both directions.
steps.expected: The OBU takes into account the speed restriction valid for Both directions.

test_cases.title: Evaluation of balise information in Shunting mode (Reverse direction)
test_cases.preconditions: Engine is in Shunting (SH) mode. Train orientation is Nominal. A balise group is crossed in the Reverse direction.
test_cases.test_inputs: Balise group data containing: 1) Speed restriction valid for Nominal direction, 2) Speed restriction valid for Reverse direction, 3) Speed restriction valid for Both directions.
test_cases.assumptions: The balise group is crossed in the Reverse direction.

steps.action: Cross the balise group in the Reverse direction while in SH mode.
steps.expected: The OBU takes into account the speed restriction valid for the Reverse direction.

steps.action: Check the status of the speed restriction valid for the Nominal direction.
steps.expected: The OBU ignores the speed restriction valid only for the Nominal direction.

steps.action: Check the status of the speed restriction valid for Both directions.
steps.expected: The OBU takes into account the speed restriction valid for Both directions.

test_cases.title: MA request parameters persistence and immediate request on new parameter receipt
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2 mode. Current MA request parameters: Repetition = Yes, Period = 10s. Time since last MA request = 12s.
test_cases.test_inputs: New MA request parameters from RBC: Repetition = Yes, Period = 5s.
test_cases.assumptions: The new parameters are received at the moment when the time since the last MA request (12s) is greater than the new period (5s).

steps.action: Receive new MA request parameters from the RBC specifying a repetition period of 5s.
steps.expected: The OBU replaces the old parameters with the new ones immediately.

steps.action: Observe the OBU's action immediately after receiving the new parameters.
steps.expected: The OBU sends an MA request immediately because the time since the last request (12s) is higher than the new repetition period (5s).

test_cases.title: MA request parameters persistence without immediate request if time is less than new period
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2 mode. Current MA request parameters: Repetition = Yes, Period = 10s. Time since last MA request = 2s.
test_cases.test_inputs: New MA request parameters from RBC: Repetition = Yes, Period = 5s.
test_cases.assumptions: The new parameters are received at the moment when the time since the last MA request (2s) is less than the new period (5s).

steps.action: Receive new MA request parameters from the RBC specifying a repetition period of 5s.
steps.expected: The OBU replaces the old parameters with the new ones immediately.

steps.action: Observe the OBU's action immediately after receiving the new parameters.
steps.expected: The OBU does not send an MA request immediately. It waits for the new repetition period to elapse from the last request.

test_cases.title: No Supervised Location defined while supervising Limit of Authority
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is supervising a Limit of Authority (LoA) with a target speed above zero. The train is approaching the end of the overlap which is a candidate for Supervised Location (SvL).
test_cases.test_inputs: Train movement towards the end of the overlap.
test_cases.assumptions: The end of the overlap is within the supervised LoA.

steps.action: Move the train towards the end of the overlap while the LoA is being supervised.
steps.expected: The OBU does not define the end of the overlap as a Supervised Location (SvL).

steps.action: Check the list of active Supervised Locations on the OBU.
steps.expected: None of the SvL candidates (end of overlap, Danger Point, end of End Section) are active as SvL.

test_cases.title: Level 1 speed restriction remains valid until new restriction received
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 1 mode. A Level 1 signalling related speed restriction of 80 km/h is active.
test_cases.test_inputs: No new speed restriction received for a duration of 10 minutes.
test_cases.assumptions: The train is moving in Level 1 mode.

steps.action: Wait for 10 minutes without receiving any new signalling related speed restriction.
steps.expected: The OBU continues to apply the 80 km/h speed restriction.

test_cases.title: Level 1 speed restriction replaced by new restriction
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 1 mode. A Level 1 signalling related speed restriction of 80 km/h is active.
test_cases.test_inputs: New Level 1 signalling related speed restriction of 60 km/h received.
test_cases.assumptions: The new restriction is received directly from a balise.

steps.action: Receive a new Level 1 signalling related speed restriction of 60 km/h.
steps.expected: The OBU replaces the 80 km/h restriction with the 60 km/h restriction immediately upon receipt.

test_cases.title: Level 1 speed restriction remains valid after switch to Level 2 until MA accepted
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 1 mode. A Level 1 signalling related speed restriction of 80 km/h is active. The OBU switches to Level 2 mode.
test_cases.test_inputs: Switch to Level 2 mode. No Level 2 MA accepted yet.
test_cases.assumptions: The switch to Level 2 is initiated by the driver or trackside.

steps.action: Switch the OBU from Level 1 to Level 2 mode.
steps.expected: The OBU remains in Level 2 mode.

steps.action: Check the active speed restrictions before a Level 2 MA is accepted.
steps.expected: The Level 1 signalling related speed restriction of 80 km/h remains valid and is applied.

test_cases.title: Maximum Train Speed defined as Static Speed Restriction
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is configured with a specific train performance profile.
test_cases.test_inputs: Maximum Train Speed value set to 200 km/h.
test_cases.assumptions: The train's actual performance allows 200 km/h.

steps.action: Set the Maximum Train Speed to 200 km/h in the OBU configuration.
steps.expected: The OBU accepts the value.

steps.action: Check how the OBU handles the 200 km/h value in its speed restriction logic.
steps.expected: The OBU treats the 200 km/h value as the Maximum Train Speed category of Static Speed Restriction.

test_cases.title: Initial state 'no speed restriction' for permitted braking distance
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is powered on and in a state where no trackside data for speed restrictions has been received yet.
test_cases.test_inputs: None (initial state).
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU is in a mode where permitted braking distance limits are applicable.

steps.action: Check the speed restriction status for permitted braking distance before any trackside data is received.
steps.expected: The OBU uses 'no speed restriction' as the initial state. No permitted-braking-distance limit constrains the train speed.

test_cases.title: Resumption of initial state 'no speed restriction' on trackside order
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2 mode. A speed restriction for permitted braking distance is currently active (e.g., 100 km/h).
test_cases.test_inputs: Trackside order to resume the initial state for speed restrictions.
test_cases.assumptions: The trackside sends a specific message or data element ordering the resumption of the initial state.

steps.action: Receive a trackside order to resume the initial state for speed restrictions.
steps.expected: The OBU clears the active speed restriction for permitted braking distance.

steps.action: Check the speed restriction status for permitted braking distance after the order.
steps.expected: The OBU uses 'no speed restriction' as the state. No permitted-braking-distance limit constrains the train speed.

test_cases.title: Safe radio connection loss triggers immediate reconnection attempt
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in operational mode. A safe radio connection is established with a specific radio system (e.g., GSM-R). EURORADIO is active.
test_cases.test_inputs: Simulated loss of safe radio connection signal from EURORADIO.
test_cases.assumptions: The radio system previously used for the successful connection is available and functional.

steps.action: Establish a safe radio connection between OBU and the radio system.
steps.expected: OBU status indicates an active safe radio connection.

steps.action: Simulate the loss of the safe radio connection via EURORADIO.
steps.expected: OBU immediately initiates an attempt to set up a new safe radio connection with the same radio system.

test_cases.title: Repeated reconnection attempts until success
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in operational mode. A communication session is established. Safe radio connection is lost.
test_cases.test_inputs: Simulated radio interference preventing reconnection for a short duration, followed by restoration of radio availability.
test_cases.assumptions: The communication session is not terminated and the train has not passed the RIU termination location.

steps.action: Cause the loss of the safe radio connection during an active session.
steps.expected: OBU starts repeating attempts to set up a new safe radio connection.

steps.action: Keep the radio system unavailable for a defined period (e.g., 10 seconds) to force failed reconnection attempts.
steps.expected: OBU continues to repeat reconnection attempts without stopping.

steps.action: Restore radio system availability.
steps.expected: OBU successfully establishes a new safe radio connection and stops repeating attempts.

test_cases.title: Reconnection attempts stop when session is terminated
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in operational mode. A communication session is established. Safe radio connection is lost.
test_cases.test_inputs: Command to terminate the communication session.
test_cases.assumptions: The train has not passed the RIU termination location.

steps.action: Cause the loss of the safe radio connection during an active session.
steps.expected: OBU starts repeating attempts to set up a new safe radio connection.

steps.action: Issue a command to terminate the communication session.
steps.expected: OBU stops repeating reconnection attempts and regards the session as terminated.

test_cases.title: Reconnection attempts stop when train passes RIU termination location
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in operational mode. A communication session is established with an RIU order specifying a termination location. Safe radio connection is lost.
test_cases.test_inputs: Train movement data simulating passage of the RIU termination location.
test_cases.assumptions: The communication session is not otherwise terminated.

steps.action: Cause the loss of the safe radio connection during an active session.
steps.expected: OBU starts repeating attempts to set up a new safe radio connection.

steps.action: Simulate the train passing the location given in the RIU order to terminate the communication session.
steps.expected: OBU stops repeating reconnection attempts.

test_cases.title: OBU initiates termination upon trackside order
test_cases.preconditions: An active communication session is established between the OBU and the trackside (RBC).
test_cases.test_inputs: Trackside sends a 'Termination of Communication Session' order.

steps.action: The trackside sends a termination order to the OBU.
steps.expected: The OBU initiates the termination of the communication session.

test_cases.title: OBU does not initiate termination without trackside order or condition
test_cases.preconditions: An active communication session is established. No termination conditions from SUBSET-026 are fulfilled.
test_cases.test_inputs: No trackside order is sent. No termination condition is triggered.

steps.action: Wait for a duration longer than the fixed waiting time without any trackside order or termination condition.
steps.expected: The OBU does not initiate the termination of the communication session.

test_cases.title: OBU repeats termination message if no acknowledgement is received
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU has initiated the termination of the communication session and sent the 'Termination of Communication Session' message.
test_cases.test_inputs: No acknowledgement is received from the trackside within the fixed waiting time.
test_cases.assumptions: The fixed waiting time is defined in SUBSET-026 Appendix A.3.1.

steps.action: The OBU sends the 'Termination of Communication Session' message.
steps.expected: The message is transmitted.

steps.action: Wait for the fixed waiting time without receiving an acknowledgement.
steps.expected: The OBU repeats the 'Termination of Communication Session' message.

test_cases.title: OBU considers session terminated after maximum repetitions without acknowledgement
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in the process of terminating the communication session and has been repeating the termination message.
test_cases.test_inputs: No acknowledgement is received after the last allowed repetition.
test_cases.assumptions: The defined number of repetitions is as per SUBSET-026 Appendix A.3.1.

steps.action: The OBU sends the 'Termination of Communication Session' message for the defined maximum number of times.
steps.expected: The message is sent the last time.

steps.action: Wait for the fixed waiting time after the last sending without receiving an acknowledgement.
steps.expected: The OBU considers the communication session terminated.

test_cases.title: Güç açıldığında GSM-R kayıt talebinin gönderilmesi
test_cases.preconditions: OBU kapalı durumdadır. GSM-R Mobil Terminal bağlıdır ve çalışır durumdadır.
test_cases.assumptions: GSM-R ağının mevcut olduğu varsayılır.

steps.action: OBU güç açma komutu verilir.
steps.expected: OBU, bağlı GSM-R Mobil Terminal(ler) için GSM-R Radyo Ağına kayıt talebi gönderir.

test_cases.title: Sürücü yeni GSM-R Radyo Ağı kimliği girdiğinde kayıt talebinin gönderilmesi
test_cases.preconditions: OBU çalışır durumdadır. GSM-R Mobil Terminal bağlıdır. Mevcut kayıt farklı bir ağ kimliği içindir.
test_cases.test_inputs: Yeni GSM-R Radyo Ağı kimliği (PLMN ID).

steps.action: Sürücü arayüzünden yeni bir GSM-R Radyo Ağı kimliği girilir.
steps.expected: OBU, yeni kimlik için GSM-R Radyo Ağına kayıt talebi gönderir.

test_cases.title: Ray kenarı komutuyla GSM-R kayıt talebinin gönderilmesi
test_cases.preconditions: OBU çalışır durumdadır. GSM-R Mobil Terminal bağlıdır.
test_cases.test_inputs: Ray kenarından gelen kayıt komutu mesajı.

steps.action: Ray kenarından GSM-R kayıt komutu gönderilir.
steps.expected: OBU, bağlı GSM-R Mobil Terminal(ler) için GSM-R Radyo Ağına kayıt talebi gönderir.

test_cases.title: Radyo Ağı tipi hatırlanmadığında varsayılan tipin kullanılması
test_cases.preconditions: OBU'da hatırlanmış Radyo Ağı tipi yoktur (ilk güç açma veya Sistem Arızası sonrası). Varsayılan Radyo Ağı tipi yapılandırılmıştır.
test_cases.assumptions: Varsayılan Radyo Ağı tipi 'GSM-R' olarak yapılandırılmıştır.

steps.action: OBU güç açılır ve Radyo Ağı tipi sorgulanır.
steps.expected: OBU, yapılandırılmış varsayılan Radyo Ağı tipini kullanır.

test_cases.title: Gerekli radyo sistemi kayıtlı değilken RBC oturumu için güvenli bağlantı talebinin gönderilmemesi
test_cases.preconditions: OBU çalışır durumdadır. Depolanan Radyo Ağı tipi gerektirdiği radyo sistemi (ör. GSM-R) kayıtlı değildir.
test_cases.test_inputs: Ray kenarından gelen RBC oturumu kurma komutu.
test_cases.assumptions: GSM-R terminali kayıtlı değildir.

steps.action: Ray kenarından RBC ile oturum kurma komutu gönderilir.
steps.expected: OBU, güvenli radyo bağlantısı kurulumu talebinde bulunmaz.

test_cases.title: GSM-R terminali kayıtlı değilken RIU oturumu için güvenli bağlantı talebinin gönderilmemesi
test_cases.preconditions: OBU çalışır durumdadır. Hiçbir GSM-R Mobil Terminal, bir GSM-R Radyo Ağına düzgün şekilde kayıtlı değildir.
test_cases.test_inputs: Ray kenarından gelen RIU ile iletişim oturumu kurma komutu.

steps.action: Ray kenarından RIU ile iletişim oturumu kurma komutu gönderilir.
steps.expected: OBU, güvenli radyo bağlantısı kurulumu talebinde bulunmaz.

test_cases.title: Güvenli radyo bağlantısı kurulduğunda sürücüye 'Connection Up' durumunun gösterilmesi
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, ilgili RBC/RIU ile güvenli radyo bağlantısı kurma sürecini başarıyla tamamlamıştır.
test_cases.assumptions: Sürücü arayüzünde bağlantı durumu göstergesi aktif ve okunabilir durumdadır.

steps.action: OBU'nun sürücü arayüzündeki güvenli radyo bağlantı durumu göstergesi gözlemlenir.
steps.expected: Göstergede 'Connection Up' durumu görünür.

test_cases.title: Bağlantı yokken sürücüye 'No Connection' durumunun gösterilmesi
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, herhangi bir RBC/RIU ile güvenli radyo bağlantısı kurmamıştır.
test_cases.assumptions: Sürücü arayüzünde bağlantı durumu göstergesi aktif ve okunabilir durumdadır.

steps.action: OBU'nun sürücü arayüzündeki güvenli radyo bağlantı durumu göstergesi gözlemlenir.
steps.expected: Göstergede 'No Connection' durumu görünür.

test_cases.title: Bağlantı kurulurken hata oluştuğunda sürücüye 'Connection Lost/Set-Up failed' durumunun gösterilmesi
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, RBC/RIU ile güvenli radyo bağlantısı kurma denemesi yapmaktadır ancak bu deneme başarısız olmuştur.
test_cases.assumptions: Sürücü arayüzünde bağlantı durumu göstergesi aktif ve okunabilir durumdadır.

steps.action: OBU'nun sürücü arayüzündeki güvenli radyo bağlantı durumu göstergesi gözlemlenir.
steps.expected: Göstergede 'Connection Lost/Set-Up failed' durumu görünür.

test_cases.title: Oturum kurulumu için ilk istek gönderildiğinde bağlantı durumu zamanlayıcısının başlatılması
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, 'No Connection' durumundadır ve ilgili RBC/RIU ile oturum kurmak için hazırdır.
test_cases.assumptions: OBU'nun iç zamanlayıcı durumu izlenebilir veya loglanabilir.

steps.action: OBU, SUBSET-026 §3.5.3.4) b) ila e) tetikleyicilerinden biriyle ilgili RBC/RIU'ya ilk güvenli radyo bağlantısı kurma isteğini gönderir.
steps.expected: OBU'nun bağlantı durumu zamanlayıcısının başlatıldığı gözlemlenir.

test_cases.title: Oturum sürdürme için ilk istek gönderildiğinde bağlantı durumu zamanlayıcısının başlatılması
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, mevcut bir oturumu sürdürmek için SUBSET-026 §3.5.4.2 veya §3.5.4.4 koşullarını tetiklemiştir ve henüz bu amaçla bir istek göndermemiştir.
test_cases.assumptions: OBU'nun iç zamanlayıcı durumu izlenebilir veya loglanabilir.

steps.action: OBU, oturumu sürdürmek için ilgili RBC/RIU'ya ilk güvenli radyo bağlantısı isteğini gönderir.
steps.expected: OBU'nun bağlantı durumu zamanlayıcısının başlatıldığı gözlemlenir.

test_cases.title: Bağlantı durumunun 'No Connection' dan 'Connection Up' a geçişinin SUBSET-026 Tablo 1 ve 2'ye uygunluğu
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, 'No Connection' durumundadır ve SUBSET-026 Tablo 2'de belirtilen geçiş koşulları sağlanmıştır.
test_cases.assumptions: SUBSET-026 Tablo 1 ve 2'deki geçiş kuralları test senaryosuna göre uygulanmıştır.

steps.action: SUBSET-026 Tablo 2'de 'No Connection' dan 'Connection Up' a geçişi sağlayan koşullar sağlanır.
steps.expected: OBU, bağlantı durumunu 'Connection Up' olarak değiştirir ve bu geçiş SUBSET-026 Tablo 1'de tanımlı geçerli bir geçiştir.

test_cases.title: Bağlantı durumunun 'Connection Up' tan 'Connection Lost/Set-Up failed' e geçişinin SUBSET-026 Tablo 1 ve 2'ye uygunluğu
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, 'Connection Up' durumundadır.
test_cases.assumptions: SUBSET-026 Tablo 1 ve 2'deki geçiş kuralları test senaryosuna göre uygulanmıştır.

steps.action: SUBSET-026 Tablo 2'de 'Connection Up' tan 'Connection Lost/Set-Up failed' e geçişi sağlayan koşullar (örneğin zamanlayıcının dolması) sağlanır.
steps.expected: OBU, bağlantı durumunu 'Connection Lost/Set-Up failed' olarak değiştirir ve bu geçiş SUBSET-026 Tablo 1'de tanımlı geçerli bir geçiştir.

test_cases.title: Geçersiz durum geçişlerinin engellenmesi
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, 'No Connection' durumundadır.
test_cases.assumptions: SUBSET-026 Tablo 1'de 'No Connection' dan doğrudan 'Connection Lost/Set-Up failed' e geçiş tanımlı değildir.

steps.action: SUBSET-026 Tablo 1'de tanımlı olmayan bir geçiş koşulu (örneğin 'No Connection' dan doğrudan 'Connection Lost/Set-Up failed' e) simüle edilir.
steps.expected: OBU, bu geçişi yapmaz ve mevcut durumu 'No Connection' olarak korur.

test_cases.title: Birden fazla RIU ile bağlantı varken mevcut infill alanına ait RIU durumunun gösterilmesi
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, birden fazla Radio Infill Unit (RIU) ile güvenli radyo bağlantısı kurmuştur ve araç, belirli bir infill alanındadır.
test_cases.assumptions: Araç konumu, mevcut infill alanını belirlemek için OBU tarafından doğru olarak algılanmaktadır.

steps.action: OBU'nun sürücü arayüzündeki güvenli radyo bağlantı durumu göstergesi gözlemlenir.
steps.expected: Göstergede, aracın bulunduğu mevcut infill alanına ait RIU'nun bağlantı durumu (örneğin 'Connection Up') görünür, diğer RIU'ların durumu değil.

test_cases.title: LRBG geçişinde geçersiz konumun geçerli konumla değiştirilmesi
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, tren konumunun bilinmediği veya geçersiz olduğu bir durumda çalışmaktadır. Araçta daha önce depolanmış geçersiz bir tren konumu bulunmaktadır.
test_cases.test_inputs: LRBG sinyali (Geçerli konum bilgisi içeren).
test_cases.assumptions: LRBG'nin OBU tarafından algılanması ve konum bilgisinin güncellenmesi anlık olarak test edilebilmektedir.

steps.action: Tren, geçerli konum bilgisi içeren bir LRBG üzerinden geçer.
steps.expected: OBU, LRBG'den gelen geçerli tren konumunu araçta depolanmış geçerli konum olarak kabul eder.

steps.action: OBU'nun depolanan tren konumu durumu kontrol edilir.
steps.expected: Daha önce depolanmış geçersiz tren konumu silinmiş ve yeni geçerli konum aktif olarak kullanılmaktadır.

test_cases.title: ORBG geçişinde geçersiz konumun geçerli konumla değiştirilmesi
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, tren konumunun bilinmediği veya geçersiz olduğu bir durumda çalışmaktadır. Araçta daha önce depolanmış geçersiz bir tren konumu bulunmaktadır.
test_cases.test_inputs: ORBG sinyali (Geçerli konum bilgisi içeren).
test_cases.assumptions: ORBG'nin OBU tarafından algılanması ve konum bilgisinin güncellenmesi anlık olarak test edilebilmektedir.

steps.action: Tren, geçerli konum bilgisi içeren bir ORBG üzerinden geçer.
steps.expected: OBU, ORBG'den gelen geçerli tren konumunu araçta depolanmış geçerli konum olarak kabul eder.

steps.action: OBU'nun depolanan tren konumu durumu kontrol edilir.
steps.expected: Daha önce depolanmış geçersiz tren konumu silinmiş ve yeni geçerli konum aktif olarak kullanılmaktadır.

test_cases.title: Aktif kabin varken tren yönünün belirlenmesi

test_cases.test_inputs: Kabin A aktif, Kabin B pasif.
test_cases.assumptions: Kabinlerin aktif/pasif durumları OBU tarafından izlenebilmektedir.

steps.action: OBU'nun tren yönü (orientation) parametresi kontrol edilir.
steps.expected: Tren yönü, aktif kabinin (Kabin A) bulunduğu taraf olarak tanımlanmıştır.

test_cases.title: Aktif kabin yokken son aktif kabine göre tren yönünün belirlenmesi
test_cases.preconditions: Trende birden fazla kabin bulunmaktadır. Önceden Kabin B aktif idi, ardından Kabin B pasife alındı ve başka bir kabin aktif edilmedi. Şu an hiçbir kabin aktif değil.
test_cases.test_inputs: Tüm kabinler pasif. Son aktif kabin: Kabin B.
test_cases.assumptions: OBU, son aktif kabin bilgisini hafızada tutmaktadır.

steps.expected: Tren yönü, son aktif kabinin (Kabin B) bulunduğu taraf olarak tanımlanmıştır.

test_cases.title: Konum tabanlı denetimlerde tahmini ön uç konumunun referans olarak kullanılması
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, konum tabanlı bir bilgiyi denetlemektedir (Örn: Sinyal geçişi). SUBSET-026'da bu fonksiyon için özel bir referans (max safe front end vb.) belirtilmemiştir.
test_cases.test_inputs: Trenin tahmini ön uç konumu (Estimated Front End Position).
test_cases.assumptions: Trenin tahmini ön uç konumu OBU tarafından hesaplanmakta ve erişilebilmektedir.

steps.action: OBU'nun konum tabanlı denetim fonksiyonunun kullandığı referans nokta kontrol edilir.
steps.expected: Denetim, trenin tahmini ön uç konumunu (estimated front end position) referans nokta olarak kullanmaktadır.

test_cases.title: End Section timer için max safe front end referansının kullanılması
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, End Section timer denetimi yapmaktadır. SUBSET-026 §3.6.1.6'ya göre bu fonksiyon için 'max safe front end' referansı belirtilmiştir.
test_cases.test_inputs: Trenin max safe front end konumu.
test_cases.assumptions: Max safe front end değeri OBU tarafından hesaplanmakta ve erişilebilmektedir.

steps.action: End Section timer denetiminin kullandığı referans nokta kontrol edilir.
steps.expected: Denetim, tahmini ön uç konumu yerine, SUBSET-026'da belirtildiği gibi 'max safe front end' konumunu referans nokta olarak kullanmaktadır.

test_cases.title: Report train position to RBC referring to last passed compliant LRBG
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in operational mode. A compliant LRBG (e.g., LRBG-100) has been passed. The OBU has reported its position to the RBC.
test_cases.test_inputs: Train moves forward. Next LRBG (LRBG-101) is passed.
test_cases.assumptions: LRBG-100 is compliant with SUBSET-026 §3.6.5.1.8. Linking consistency is not checked or LRBG-100 is not marked as unlinked.

steps.action: Observe the OBU's position report to the RBC after passing LRBG-100.
steps.expected: The OBU reports the train position to the RBC referring to LRBG-100.

steps.action: Move the train to pass the next LRBG (LRBG-101) which is also compliant.
steps.expected: The OBU updates the position report to refer to LRBG-101.

test_cases.title: Accept trackside information referring to recently reported LRBG
test_cases.preconditions: OBU has reported position referring to LRBG-100. The minimum number of recently reported LRBGs is set to 2 (per SUBSET-026 §3.6.2.2.2 c). LRBG-100 and LRBG-101 are in the recent history.
test_cases.test_inputs: RBC sends trackside information (e.g., movement authority) referring to LRBG-100.
test_cases.assumptions: LRBG-100 is within the minimum number of recently reported LRBGs.

steps.action: Send trackside information from RBC referring to LRBG-100.
steps.expected: The OBU accepts the trackside information.

test_cases.title: Reject trackside information referring to LRBG outside recent history
test_cases.preconditions: OBU has reported position referring to LRBG-102. The minimum number of recently reported LRBGs is set to 2. The recent history contains LRBG-101 and LRBG-102. LRBG-100 is no longer in the recent history.
test_cases.test_inputs: RBC sends trackside information referring to LRBG-100.
test_cases.assumptions: LRBG-100 is not within the minimum number of recently reported LRBGs.

steps.action: Send trackside information from RBC referring to LRBG-100.
steps.expected: The OBU rejects the trackside information.

test_cases.title: Compliance check for linked LRBG
test_cases.preconditions: Linking consistency is checked. LRBG-200 is linked and announced in linking. LRBG-200 is passed.
test_cases.test_inputs: Train passes LRBG-200.
test_cases.assumptions: LRBG-200 meets the conditions of SUBSET-026 §3.6.5.1.8 when linking consistency is checked.

steps.action: Pass LRBG-200.
steps.expected: The OBU considers LRBG-200 compliant and reports the train position to the RBC referring to LRBG-200.

test_cases.title: Compliance check for unlinked LRBG
test_cases.preconditions: Linking consistency is not checked. LRBG-300 is not marked as unlinked. LRBG-300 is passed.
test_cases.test_inputs: Train passes LRBG-300.
test_cases.assumptions: LRBG-300 meets the conditions of SUBSET-026 §3.6.5.1.8 when linking consistency is not checked.

steps.action: Pass LRBG-300.
steps.expected: The OBU considers LRBG-300 compliant and reports the train position to the RBC referring to LRBG-300.

test_cases.title: OBU ignores information invalid for train orientation
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is powered on and in operational mode. Train orientation is set to 'Forward'.
test_cases.test_inputs: Transmit a message containing data valid for 'Reverse' orientation via the selected transmission medium.
test_cases.assumptions: The transmission medium allows injection of orientation-specific data.

steps.action: Inject data valid for 'Reverse' orientation into the OBU while the train orientation is 'Forward'.
steps.expected: The OBU ignores the received data and does not update its internal state with this information.

steps.action: Inject data valid for 'Forward' orientation into the OBU.
steps.expected: The OBU accepts and processes the data, updating its internal state accordingly.

test_cases.title: OBU rejects one-direction data when orientation is unknown
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in a state where train orientation cannot be related to the direction of the trackside device (e.g., unknown balise group crossing direction for SL/PS/SH engines).
test_cases.test_inputs: 1. Data valid for 'Forward' only. 2. Data valid for 'Both' directions.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU can be forced into a state where orientation is unknown relative to the trackside device.

steps.action: Transmit data valid for 'Forward' direction only to the OBU.
steps.expected: The OBU rejects the data.

steps.action: Transmit data valid for 'Both' directions to the OBU.
steps.expected: The OBU evaluates and accepts the data.

test_cases.title: Interpretation of continuous profile data with incremental distances
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is ready to receive continuous profile data. Previous data state is known (e.g., Value A).
test_cases.test_inputs: Sequence of values: [Value B, Value C, Value D]. Distances: [10m, 20m, 0m (end-of-profile not set)].
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU exposes the interpreted profile values for verification.

steps.action: Transmit continuous profile data with first value B and distance 10m.
steps.expected: The OBU applies the previously received data (Value A) over the first 10m distance.

steps.action: Transmit the next value C and distance 20m.
steps.expected: The OBU applies Value B over the next 20m distance (from 10m to 30m).

steps.action: Transmit the last value D and distance 0m (not end-of-profile).
steps.expected: The OBU applies Value C over the next distance (from 30m to 30m, effectively zero length for C if distance is 0, but the rule says 'each value n applies over the following incremental distance n+1'. Wait, the requirement says 'each value n applies over the following incremental distance n+1'. Let's re-read carefully: 'each value n applies over the following incremental distance n+1'. This implies the distance associated with value n is the distance to the next value. So Value B applies over the distance to Value C. Value C applies over the distance to Value D. Value D applies without limit. The 'previously received data applies over the first distance' means the data before the first received value applies over the distance to the first received value. So: Dist 1 (10m) -> Prev Data. Dist 2 (20m) -> Value B. Dist 3 (0m) -> Value C. Value D applies without limit. Let's adjust the test to reflect this standard interpretation of ETCS profile data where the distance is the length of the segment *before* the next value or the segment *of* the current value? The requirement text: 'each value n applies over the following incremental distance n+1'. This is slightly ambiguous phrasing but usually in ETCS, the distance is the length of the segment for the current value until the next value. Let's assume the standard ETCS interpretation: The distance field indicates the length of the segment for the *current* value. So Value B applies for 10m? No, 'previously received data applies over the first distance'. This implies the first distance is the gap before the first value. So: Distance 1 (10m) is covered by Prev Data. Value B starts at 10m. Distance 2 (20m) is covered by Value B. Value C starts at 30m. Distance 3 (0m) is covered by Value C. Value D starts at 30m. Value D applies without limit. Let's test this.

steps.action: Verify the profile interpretation at distance 5m.
steps.expected: The OBU reports the previously received data (Value A).

steps.action: Verify the profile interpretation at distance 15m.
steps.expected: The OBU reports Value B.

steps.action: Verify the profile interpretation at distance 35m.
steps.expected: The OBU reports Value D (since Value C had 0m length, Value D starts at 30m and applies without limit).

test_cases.title: Interpretation of continuous profile data with end-of-profile value
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is ready to receive continuous profile data.
test_cases.test_inputs: Sequence of values: [Value B, End-of-Profile]. Distances: [10m, 0m].
test_cases.assumptions: End-of-profile value is a specific reserved value defined in SUBSET-026.

steps.action: Transmit continuous profile data with Value B and distance 10m.
steps.expected: The OBU applies previously received data over the first 10m.

steps.action: Transmit the End-of-Profile value and distance 0m.
steps.expected: The OBU applies Value B over the next 0m (effectively ending the profile at 10m). The profile is considered complete.

steps.action: Verify the profile interpretation at distance 15m.
steps.expected: The OBU does not apply Value B or any new value beyond the end-of-profile marker, or reverts to default/previous state as per specific ETCS rules for end-of-profile (usually the last valid value before EOP applies, or the profile ends). The requirement says 'last value applies without limit unless it is the end-of-profile value'. This implies if it IS the end-of-profile value, it does NOT apply without limit. So the profile ends.

test_cases.title: Interpretation of location data with unsigned increments
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is ready to receive location data. Previous data state is known (e.g., Location Data A).
test_cases.test_inputs: Location data sequence: [Data B, Data C]. Distances: [5m, 10m].
test_cases.assumptions: Location data can be single values or sets.

steps.action: Transmit location data B with distance 5m.
steps.expected: The OBU applies the previously received data (Data A) over the first 5m distance.

steps.action: Transmit location data C with distance 10m.
steps.expected: The OBU applies Data B over the next 10m distance (from 5m to 15m).

steps.action: Verify the location data at distance 2m.
steps.expected: The OBU reports Data A.

steps.action: Verify the location data at distance 10m.
steps.expected: The OBU reports Data B.

test_cases.title: Interpretation of non-continuous profile data with overlapping elements
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is ready to receive non-continuous profile data. Initial data is known (e.g., Default Value).
test_cases.test_inputs: Element 1: Value A, Length 10m, Start Distance 5m. Element 2: Value B, Length 10m, Start Distance 5m (overlapping).
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU can handle overlapping elements as per SUBSET-026.

steps.action: Transmit Element 1 (Value A, Length 10m) with start distance 5m from previous data.
steps.expected: The OBU applies the previously received data (Default Value) over the first 5m. Value A applies from 5m to 15m.

steps.action: Transmit Element 2 (Value B, Length 10m) with start distance 5m from the start of Element 1.
steps.expected: The OBU accepts the overlap. Value B starts at 5m + 5m = 10m and applies for 10m (10m to 20m). The OBU must resolve the overlap according to the standard (usually later data overrides or specific priority, but the requirement just says 'accept that elements overlap').

steps.action: Verify the profile value at distance 12m.
steps.expected: The OBU reports the value corresponding to the overlapping element as defined by the interpretation rules (e.g., Value B if it overrides, or a specific conflict resolution). The test verifies that the OBU does not crash or reject the data due to overlap.

test_cases.title: Interpretation of linking information for balise groups
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is ready to receive linking information.
test_cases.test_inputs: Linking data: [Link A, Link B, Link C]. Distances: [100m, 50m, 0m].
test_cases.assumptions: The first distance is to the first announced balise group.

steps.action: Transmit linking information with Link A and distance 100m.
steps.expected: The OBU interprets Link A as the linking data for the first announced balise group, located 100m away.

steps.action: Transmit the next linking data Link B and distance 50m.
steps.expected: The OBU interprets Link B as the linking data for the second announced balise group, located 50m after the first group (total 150m from start).

steps.action: Transmit the next linking data Link C and distance 0m.
steps.expected: The OBU interprets Link C as the linking data for the third announced balise group, located 0m after the second group (total 150m from start, same location as second group if distance is 0, or just the next group).

test_cases.title: Location accuracy from linking information
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in operational mode. A balise group (BG-A) is detected. Linking information is available and contains location accuracy for BG-A.
test_cases.test_inputs: Linking information with location accuracy = 10m for BG-A.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU exposes the determined location accuracy for the current reference balise group for observation.

steps.action: Detect balise group BG-A and receive linking information containing location accuracy for BG-A.
steps.expected: The OBU determines the location accuracy of BG-A as 10m from the linking information.

test_cases.title: Location accuracy from National Value when linking is not available
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in operational mode. A balise group (BG-B) is detected. No linking information is available for BG-B. A National Value for location accuracy is configured (e.g., 20m).
test_cases.test_inputs: No linking information. National Value = 20m.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU exposes the determined location accuracy for the current reference balise group for observation.

steps.action: Detect balise group BG-B without linking information.
steps.expected: The OBU determines the location accuracy of BG-B as 20m from the applicable National Value.

test_cases.title: Location accuracy from Default Value when no National Value applies
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in operational mode. A balise group (BG-C) is detected. No linking information is available. No National Value is applicable for the current location. A Default Value is configured (e.g., 30m).
test_cases.test_inputs: No linking information. No National Value. Default Value = 30m.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU exposes the determined location accuracy for the current reference balise group for observation.

steps.action: Detect balise group BG-C without linking information and without applicable National Value.
steps.expected: The OBU determines the location accuracy of BG-C as 30m from the Default Value.

test_cases.title: Location accuracy is not updated after determination
test_cases.preconditions: OBU has determined the location accuracy of the current reference balise group (BG-A) as 10m from linking information.
test_cases.test_inputs: New linking information with location accuracy = 15m for BG-A. Change in National Value to 25m.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU exposes the determined location accuracy for the current reference balise group for observation.

steps.action: Receive new linking information for BG-A with a different location accuracy (15m).
steps.expected: The OBU retains the previously determined location accuracy of 10m for BG-A.

steps.action: Change the applicable National Value to 25m.
steps.expected: The OBU retains the previously determined location accuracy of 10m for BG-A.

test_cases.title: Confidence interval calculation without consist length uncertainty
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in a situation where consist length uncertainty is not applicable (e.g., single unit). Location accuracy of reference BG is 10m. Over-reading amount is 5m. Under-reading amount is 5m.
test_cases.test_inputs: Location accuracy = 10m, Over-reading = 5m, Under-reading = 5m.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU exposes the min safe front end, estimated front end, and max safe front end positions for observation.

steps.action: Evaluate the train front end position confidence interval.
steps.expected: The min safe front end is calculated as Estimated Front End - (Location Accuracy + Under-reading) = Estimated - 15m. The max safe front end is calculated as Estimated Front End + (Location Accuracy + Over-reading) = Estimated + 15m.

test_cases.title: Confidence interval calculation with consist length uncertainty
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in a consist-length-related situation defined in SUBSET-026 §3.6.4.1.5. Location accuracy of reference BG is 10m. Over-reading amount is 5m. Under-reading amount is 5m. Consist length uncertainty is 2m.
test_cases.test_inputs: Location accuracy = 10m, Over-reading = 5m, Under-reading = 5m, Consist length uncertainty = 2m.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU exposes the min safe front end, estimated front end, and max safe front end positions for observation.

steps.action: Evaluate the train front end position confidence interval.
steps.expected: The min safe front end is calculated as Estimated Front End - (Location Accuracy + Under-reading + Consist Length Uncertainty) = Estimated - 17m. The max safe front end is calculated as Estimated Front End + (Location Accuracy + Over-reading + Consist Length Uncertainty) = Estimated + 17m.

test_cases.title: SOLR selection while linking consistency is checked
test_cases.preconditions: Linking consistency is being checked. Balise group BG-1 is the current SOLR. Linking information announces BG-2 as the next reference.
test_cases.test_inputs: Linking information announcing BG-2.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU exposes the current SOLR identifier for observation.

steps.action: Receive linking information announcing BG-2.
steps.expected: The OBU updates the SOLR to BG-2, as it is the most recently received balise group announced in linking information.

test_cases.title: SOLR selection while linking consistency is not checked
test_cases.preconditions: Linking consistency is not being checked. Balise group BG-1 is the last received balise group.
test_cases.test_inputs: No new balise groups received.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU exposes the current SOLR identifier for observation.
