test_cases.test_inputs: Simulate conditions that trigger multiple MA request reasons as defined in SUBSET-026 §3.8.2.1.1.
test_cases.assumptions: The RBC or a test tool can capture and decode the MA request message to verify the content of the 'MA request reasons' field.

steps.action: Trigger a condition that results in a single MA request reason (e.g., Section timer expiry).
steps.expected: OBU sends an MA request to the RBC. The message contains only that specific reason.

steps.action: Trigger a second condition that results in a different MA request reason while the first condition is still relevant or just before the next request.
steps.expected: OBU sends an MA request to the RBC. The message contains both applicable reasons.

test_cases.title: MA request triggered by perturbation-location criterion
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2. The train is moving. The perturbation-location criterion is configured and active.
test_cases.test_inputs: Train speed and position data such that the train front crosses the calculated perturbation location.
test_cases.assumptions: The perturbation location is calculated based on the current train speed and acceleration/deceleration profile as per SUBSET-026 §3.8.2.2.1.

steps.action: Move the train front to a position just before the calculated perturbation location.
steps.expected: No MA request is sent to the RBC.

steps.action: Move the train front so that it passes the calculated perturbation location.
steps.expected: OBU triggers and sends an MA request to the RBC.

test_cases.title: MA request triggered by Section timer/LOA speed timer criterion
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2. The Section timer or LOA speed timer is running.
test_cases.test_inputs: Time progression to reach the timer limit defined by the criterion.
test_cases.assumptions: The timer value is set to a short duration for testing purposes to avoid long wait times.

steps.action: Wait until the time resulting from the Section timer/LOA speed timer criterion is reached.
steps.expected: OBU triggers and sends an MA request to the RBC.

test_cases.title: MA request on track description deletion (valid situation)
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2. A track description is currently stored in the OBU.
test_cases.test_inputs: RBC sends a message deleting a part of the track description under a situation defined in SUBSET-026 Appendix A.3.4, excluding situations a, b, f, and k (e.g., situation c).
test_cases.assumptions: The specific situation chosen (e.g., c) is one that requires an MA request according to the requirement.

steps.action: Receive a track description deletion message from the RBC corresponding to a valid situation (not a, b, f, or k).
steps.expected: OBU sends an MA request to the RBC.

test_cases.title: No MA request on track description deletion (excluded situations)
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2. A track description is currently stored in the OBU.
test_cases.test_inputs: RBC sends a message deleting a part of the track description under one of the excluded situations: a, b, f, or k.
test_cases.assumptions: The test verifies that the OBU does NOT send an MA request for these specific excluded cases, ensuring compliance with the exception clause.

steps.action: Receive a track description deletion message from the RBC corresponding to situation 'a' (or b, f, or k).
steps.expected: OBU does NOT send an MA request to the RBC.

test_cases.title: End Section timer start upon passing start location
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Full Supervision mode. A Movement Authority (MA) containing an End Section timer start location and a non-zero timeout value is received from trackside. The train is moving towards the start location.
test_cases.test_inputs: MA with End Section timer start location at 1000m from current position, timeout value 30s.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU's max safe front end is calculated correctly based on current speed and braking curve.

steps.action: Move the train such that the max safe front end is just before the End Section timer start location (e.g., 999m).
steps.expected: The End Section timer is not started (timer value is 0 or inactive).

steps.action: Continue moving the train such that the max safe front end passes the End Section timer start location (e.g., 1001m).
steps.expected: The End Section timer starts counting down from the received timeout value (30s).

test_cases.title: End Section timer timeout consequences
test_cases.preconditions: The End Section timer is running. The current MA includes location-based information (e.g., speed limits) and a non-zero target speed at the End of Movement Authority (EOA).
test_cases.test_inputs: End Section timer timeout value set to 5s for testability. Current train position is 500m from EOA.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU can simulate or wait for the timer to expire.

steps.action: Allow the End Section timer to exceed the timeout value.
steps.expected: The OBU withdraws the EOA/LOA to the train's current position (500m). The location-based information listed in SUBSET-026 Appendix A.3.4 is deleted. The target speed at the new EOA (current position) is set to zero.

test_cases.title: LOA speed timer start in Level 2
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is operating in Level 2. A new MA message is received from trackside.
test_cases.test_inputs: MA message with timestamp T0. LOA speed timer timeout value is 10s.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU clock is synchronized with the trackside message timestamp.

steps.action: Receive the MA message at time T0.
steps.expected: The LOA speed timer starts at the timestamp T0 of the message.

test_cases.title: LOA speed timer start in Level 1
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is operating in Level 1. The train is approaching a balise group that provides the MA.
test_cases.test_inputs: Balise group with MA information. LOA speed timer timeout value is 10s.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU correctly identifies the first balise of the group.

steps.action: Pass the first encountered balise of the balise group giving the MA.
steps.expected: The LOA speed timer starts at the moment of passing the first balise.

test_cases.title: LOA speed timer timeout consequences
test_cases.preconditions: The LOA speed timer is running. The current MA includes a LOA with a non-zero speed and location-based information.
test_cases.test_inputs: LOA speed timer timeout value set to 5s. LOA speed is 100 km/h.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU can simulate or wait for the timer to expire.

steps.action: Allow the LOA speed timer to exceed the timeout value.
steps.expected: The speed associated with the LOA is set to zero. The LOA becomes an EOA. The Supervised Location (SvL) is defined per SUBSET-026 §3.8.4.5. The location-based information listed in SUBSET-026 Appendix A.3.4 is deleted.

test_cases.title: Overlap timer start upon passing start location
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Full Supervision mode. A MA containing an Overlap timer start location and a non-zero timeout value is received. The train is moving towards the start location.
test_cases.test_inputs: MA with Overlap timer start location at 2000m from current position, timeout value 60s.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU's max safe front end is calculated correctly.

steps.action: Move the train such that the max safe front end is just before the Overlap timer start location.
steps.expected: The Overlap timer is not started.

steps.action: Continue moving the train such that the max safe front end passes the Overlap timer start location.
steps.expected: The Overlap timer starts counting down from the received timeout value (60s).

test_cases.title: Overlap timer start with infinite timeout
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Full Supervision mode. A MA containing an Overlap timer start location and a timeout value of 'infinite' is received. The train is moving towards the start location.
test_cases.test_inputs: MA with Overlap timer start location at 2000m, timeout value 'infinite'.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU interprets 'infinite' as a special value that does not expire.

steps.action: Move the train such that the max safe front end passes the Overlap timer start location.
steps.expected: The Overlap timer is regarded as started (active state), even though the timeout value is 'infinite'.

test_cases.title: Overlap timer timeout consequences
test_cases.preconditions: The Overlap timer is running. The current MA includes an overlap with a release speed and location-based information. The EOA has a non-zero target speed.
test_cases.test_inputs: Overlap timer timeout value set to 5s. Overlap release speed is 50 km/h.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU can simulate or wait for the timer to expire.

steps.action: Allow the Overlap timer to exceed the timeout value.
steps.expected: The overlap and its associated release speed are deleted. The Supervised Location is redetermined per SUBSET-026 §3.8.4.5. Location-based information per Appendix A.3.4 is deleted. The target speed at the End of Movement Authority is set to zero.

test_cases.title: Overlap timer expiration upon train standstill
test_cases.preconditions: The Overlap timer has been started and is running. The train is moving.
test_cases.test_inputs: Overlap timer timeout value 60s. Train speed reduced to 0 km/h.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU detects standstill when speed is 0 for a defined period (e.g., 1s).

steps.action: Bring the train to a complete standstill while the Overlap timer is running.
steps.expected: The OBU treats the Overlap timer as expired. The consequences defined for Overlap time-out in SUBSET-026 §3.8.4.4.2 are applied (overlap deleted, SvL redetermined, EOA speed set to zero).

test_cases.title: Overlap timer timeout upon receiving new MA with rear start location
test_cases.preconditions: No Overlap timer is currently running. The OBU's max safe front end is at position 1500m. A new MA is received with an Overlap timer start location at 1000m (rear of max safe front end).
test_cases.test_inputs: New MA with Overlap timer start location at 1000m.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU correctly compares the start location with the max safe front end position.

steps.action: Receive the new MA with the Overlap timer start location in rear of the max safe front end.
steps.expected: The OBU considers the Overlap timer as having exceeded its time-out value. The consequences defined in SUBSET-026 §3.8.4.4.2 are applied.

test_cases.title: Supervised Location determination with active overlap
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU has an active overlap that has not timed out. A Danger Point and an End Section are also defined in the MA.
test_cases.test_inputs: Overlap end at 2000m, Danger Point at 2500m, End Section end at 3000m.
test_cases.assumptions: The overlap is valid and not expired.

steps.action: Query the OBU for the current Supervised Location.
steps.expected: The Supervised Location is set to the end of the overlap (2000m).

test_cases.title: Supervised Location determination with no overlap but Danger Point
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU has no active overlap (or it has timed out). A Danger Point is defined in the MA. An End Section is also defined.
test_cases.test_inputs: Danger Point at 2500m, End Section end at 3000m.
test_cases.assumptions: The overlap is not present or has expired.

steps.action: Query the OBU for the current Supervised Location.
steps.expected: The Supervised Location is set to the Danger Point (2500m).

test_cases.title: Supervised Location determination with no overlap or Danger Point
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU has no active overlap and no Danger Point defined in the MA. An End Section is defined.
test_cases.test_inputs: End Section end at 3000m.
test_cases.assumptions: No overlap or Danger Point is present.

steps.action: Query the OBU for the current Supervised Location.
steps.expected: The Supervised Location is set to the end of the End Section (3000m).

test_cases.title: Infill MA evaluation in Full Supervision
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Full Supervision mode. An infill MA is received.
test_cases.test_inputs: Infill MA with valid linking information.
test_cases.assumptions: The infill MA is correctly formatted.

steps.action: Receive the infill MA while in Full Supervision mode.
steps.expected: The OBU evaluates the infill MA and updates the movement authority accordingly.

test_cases.title: Infill MA evaluation in Automatic Driving
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Automatic Driving mode. An infill MA is received.
test_cases.test_inputs: Infill MA with valid linking information.
test_cases.assumptions: The infill MA is correctly formatted.

steps.action: Receive the infill MA while in Automatic Driving mode.
steps.expected: The OBU evaluates the infill MA and updates the movement authority accordingly.

test_cases.title: Infill MA evaluation in Limited Supervision
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Limited Supervision mode. An infill MA is received.
test_cases.test_inputs: Infill MA with valid linking information.
test_cases.assumptions: The infill MA is correctly formatted.

steps.action: Receive the infill MA while in Limited Supervision mode.
steps.expected: The OBU evaluates the infill MA and updates the movement authority accordingly.

test_cases.title: Infill MA rejection in other modes
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in a mode other than Full Supervision, Automatic Driving, or Limited Supervision (e.g., On Shunt, Standstill). An infill MA is received.
test_cases.test_inputs: Infill MA with valid linking information.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU is in a mode where infill MA evaluation is not permitted.

steps.action: Receive the infill MA while in a non-permitted mode.
steps.expected: The OBU does not evaluate the infill MA. The movement authority remains unchanged.

test_cases.title: Infill MA evaluation with available linking information
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Full Supervision mode. Linking information for the main signal balise group is available. An infill MA referring to that balise group is received.
test_cases.test_inputs: Infill MA with valid linking information for the main signal balise group.
test_cases.assumptions: The linking information is correctly stored in the OBU.

steps.action: Receive the infill MA with available linking information.
steps.expected: The OBU evaluates the infill MA and updates the movement authority accordingly.

test_cases.title: Infill MA rejection without linking information
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Full Supervision mode. Linking information for the main signal balise group is NOT available. An infill MA referring to that balise group is received.
test_cases.test_inputs: Infill MA without valid linking information for the main signal balise group.
test_cases.assumptions: The linking information is missing or invalid in the OBU.

steps.action: Receive the infill MA without available linking information.
steps.expected: The OBU does not evaluate the infill MA. The movement authority remains unchanged.

test_cases.title: Replacement of previous MA data upon receiving a new MA from RBC
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is currently supervising a valid MA (MA_old) with specific speed limits and location data.
test_cases.test_inputs: A new MA (MA_new) is transmitted by the RBC. MA_new contains different speed limits and location data than MA_old.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU is in a state where it can accept new MA data (e.g., not in a critical failure state).

steps.action: Transmit a new MA (MA_new) from the RBC to the OBU.
steps.expected: The OBU receives the new MA.

steps.action: Check the OBU's internal MA data storage.
steps.expected: All data of the previous MA (MA_old) has been replaced by the data of the new MA (MA_new). No residual data from MA_old remains.

test_cases.title: Replacement of previous MA data upon receiving a new MA from a main-signal balise group
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is currently supervising a valid MA (MA_old). The train is approaching a main signal with a balise group.
test_cases.test_inputs: A new MA (MA_new) is read from a main-signal balise group (non-infill information). MA_new contains different data than MA_old.
test_cases.assumptions: The balise group is correctly identified as a main-signal balise group and not an infill group.

steps.action: Pass the main-signal balise group containing the new MA (MA_new).
steps.expected: The OBU reads the new MA from the balise group.

steps.action: Check the OBU's internal MA data storage.
steps.expected: All data of the previous MA (MA_old) has been replaced by the data of the new MA (MA_new).

test_cases.title: Partial replacement of MA data upon receiving infill information
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is currently supervising a valid MA (MA_old) that extends beyond the next main signal. The next main signal has a balise group.
test_cases.test_inputs: An infill MA (MA_infill) is received. MA_infill contains data for the section beyond the announced balise group at the next main signal.
test_cases.assumptions: The infill MA is correctly identified as infill information.

steps.action: Receive the infill MA (MA_infill).
steps.expected: The OBU processes the infill MA.

steps.action: Check the OBU's internal MA data storage for the section up to the next main signal.
steps.expected: The data for the section up to the next main signal remains unchanged from MA_old.

steps.action: Check the OBU's internal MA data storage for the section beyond the next main signal.
steps.expected: The data for the section beyond the next main signal is replaced by the data from MA_infill.

test_cases.title: Start of new MA section at infill location reference
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is supervising an MA. The next main signal has a balise group at a specific location reference (L_ref).
test_cases.test_inputs: An infill MA is received.
test_cases.assumptions: The infill MA is associated with the balise group at the next main signal.

steps.action: Receive the infill MA.
steps.expected: The OBU processes the infill MA.

steps.action: Check the OBU's MA section definition.
steps.expected: A new MA section starts at the infill location reference, which is the balise group at the next main signal (L_ref).

test_cases.title: Treatment of new MA with SvL as MA shortening while supervising LOA
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is supervising an LOA (Limit of Authority). Location based information is stored as per SUBSET-026 Appendix A.3.4.
test_cases.test_inputs: A new MA is received that defines an SvL (Speed Limit). The SvL is located within the current LOA.
test_cases.assumptions: The new MA is valid and correctly formatted.

steps.action: Receive the new MA defining an SvL.
steps.expected: The OBU treats the new MA as an MA shortening.

steps.action: Check the stored location based information.
steps.expected: The stored location based information listed in SUBSET-026 Appendix A.3.4 is deleted accordingly.

test_cases.title: Treatment of new MA with SvL as MA shortening regardless of SvL location
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is supervising an LOA. Location based information is stored as per SUBSET-026 Appendix A.3.4.
test_cases.test_inputs: A new MA is received that defines an SvL. The SvL is located beyond the current LOA.
test_cases.assumptions: The new MA is valid and correctly formatted.

steps.action: Receive the new MA defining an SvL.
steps.expected: The OBU treats the new MA as an MA shortening.

steps.action: Check the stored location based information.
steps.expected: The stored location based information listed in SUBSET-026 Appendix A.3.4 is deleted accordingly.

test_cases.title: Repositioning information not treated as MA shortening
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is supervising an MA.
test_cases.test_inputs: Repositioning information is received.
test_cases.assumptions: The repositioning information is valid.

steps.action: Receive repositioning information.
steps.expected: The OBU processes the repositioning information.

steps.action: Check the OBU's MA status.
steps.expected: The OBU does not regard the reception of repositioning information as an MA shortening.

test_cases.title: New MA ending with LOA not treated as MA shortening
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is supervising an MA.
test_cases.test_inputs: A new MA is received that ends with an LOA.
test_cases.assumptions: The new MA is valid and correctly formatted.

steps.action: Receive the new MA ending with an LOA.
steps.expected: The OBU processes the new MA.

steps.action: Check the OBU's MA status.
steps.expected: The OBU does not regard the reception of the new MA ending with an LOA as an MA shortening.

test_cases.title: Adopt shortened MA when train is rear of Indication supervision limit
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in a mode where MA is active. The current MA has a defined Indication supervision limit. The train front end position is known to be rear of the proposed shortened MA's Indication supervision limit.
test_cases.test_inputs: RBC request to shorten MA with new MA data, mode profile, and SH-area balise group list.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU can simulate or receive a valid RBC request for MA shortening. The train position is set such that the front end is rear of the new Indication supervision limit.

steps.action: Send an RBC request to shorten the MA to a new value where the train front end is rear of the new Indication supervision limit.
steps.expected: The OBU adopts the proposed shortened MA, including its mode profile and SH-area balise group list.

steps.action: Check the communication log or status message sent to the RBC.
steps.expected: The OBU informs the RBC that it has adopted the new MA.

test_cases.title: Reject shortened MA when train is not rear of Indication supervision limit
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in a mode where MA is active. The current MA has a defined Indication supervision limit. The train front end position is known to be at or ahead of the proposed shortened MA's Indication supervision limit.
test_cases.test_inputs: RBC request to shorten MA with new MA data, mode profile, and SH-area balise group list.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU can simulate or receive a valid RBC request for MA shortening. The train position is set such that the front end is not rear of the new Indication supervision limit.

steps.action: Send an RBC request to shorten the MA to a new value where the train front end is not rear of the new Indication supervision limit.
steps.expected: The OBU rejects the request and keeps the previous MA, mode profile, and SH-area balise group list.

steps.action: Check the communication log or status message sent to the RBC.
steps.expected: The OBU informs the RBC that it has rejected the new MA.

test_cases.title: Boundary condition: Train front end exactly at Indication supervision limit
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in a mode where MA is active. The train front end position is set exactly at the proposed shortened MA's Indication supervision limit.
test_cases.test_inputs: RBC request to shorten MA with new MA data, mode profile, and SH-area balise group list.
test_cases.assumptions: The requirement states 'rear of' the limit. Being exactly at the limit is not 'rear of'. Therefore, the OBU should reject the request.

steps.action: Send an RBC request to shorten the MA to a new value where the train front end is exactly at the new Indication supervision limit.
steps.expected: The OBU rejects the request and keeps the previous MA, mode profile, and SH-area balise group list.

steps.action: Check the communication log or status message sent to the RBC.
steps.expected: The OBU informs the RBC that it has rejected the new MA.

test_cases.title: OBU'nun desteklemediği infill ortamı talebinin yok sayılması
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, desteklenen infill ortamları listesine göre yapılandırılmıştır. OBU, geçerli bir balis grubundan önceki seyrine ait güncel bilgiyi almıştır.
test_cases.test_inputs: Desteklenmeyen infill ortamı talep eden bir announcement balis grubu simülasyonu.
test_cases.assumptions: OBU'nun desteklemediği bir infill ortamı (örneğin, OBU'da bulunmayan bir radyo frekansı veya protokol) test senaryosunda tanımlanmıştır.

steps.action: OBU'ya, desteklenmeyen bir infill ortamı talep eden bir announcement balis grubu sinyali gönderilir.
steps.expected: OBU, bu talebi yok sayar ve infill ortamı kurulumu için herhangi bir işlem başlatmaz.

steps.action: OBU'nun çalışma durumu ve mevcut seyrine ait bilgi akışı gözlemlenir.
steps.expected: OBU, önceki balis grubundan alınan bilgilere göre çalışmaya devam eder ve seyrine ait parametreler değişmez.

test_cases.title: OBU reads next main signal balise group and ignores subsequent infill
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in operational mode and has not yet read the next main signal balise group.
test_cases.test_inputs: Loop infill data stream, Next main signal balise group data.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU is configured to process infill data from the loop before reading the next main signal balise group.

steps.action: Transmit infill information from the loop to the OBU.
steps.expected: OBU processes and stores the infill information.

steps.action: Transmit the next main signal balise group data to the OBU.
steps.expected: OBU reads and processes the next main signal balise group.

steps.action: Transmit additional infill information from the loop to the OBU.
steps.expected: OBU ignores the additional infill information and does not update its state based on it.

test_cases.title: OBU detects missed next main signal balise group and ignores subsequent infill
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in operational mode and has not yet read the next main signal balise group.
test_cases.test_inputs: Loop infill data stream, Timeout or detection mechanism for missed balise group.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU has a defined mechanism to detect that the next main signal balise group was missed (e.g., timeout or position-based detection).

steps.action: Transmit infill information from the loop to the OBU.
steps.expected: OBU processes and stores the infill information.

steps.action: Simulate the condition where the next main signal balise group is missed (e.g., by not transmitting it and allowing the detection timeout to expire).
steps.expected: OBU detects that the next main signal balise group was missed.

steps.action: Transmit additional infill information from the loop to the OBU.
steps.expected: OBU ignores the additional infill information and does not update its state based on it.

test_cases.title: GSM-R yokken RIU oturum emrinin yok sayılması
test_cases.preconditions: OBU üzerinde GSM-R radyo sistemi kurulu değildir. Balise grubundan RIU ile iletişim oturumu kurma emri alınabilir.
test_cases.test_inputs: Balise grubu verisi: RIU oturum emri.

steps.action: OBU'ya RIU ile iletişim oturumu kurma emri içeren bir balise grubu verilir.
steps.expected: OBU, emri yok sayar ve RIU ile herhangi bir iletişim oturumu başlatmaz.

test_cases.title: Emredilen RIU ile oturumun kurulması ve diğer oturumun sonlandırılması
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, RIU-A ile aktif bir iletişim oturumuna sahiptir. Balise grubundan RIU-B ile oturum kurma emri alınmıştır. Emredilen konum henüz geçilmemiştir.
test_cases.test_inputs: Balise grubu verisi: RIU-B ile oturum emri ve konum bilgisi.
test_cases.assumptions: OBU, yeni bir oturum işleyebildiğinde RIU-B'ye bağlanabilir.

steps.action: OBU, emredilen konuma ulaşır.
steps.expected: OBU, RIU-A ile olan mevcut oturumu sonlandırır.

steps.action: OBU, yeni bir oturum işleyebilir hale gelir.
steps.expected: OBU, emredilen RIU-B ile iletişim oturumu kurar.

test_cases.title: Degrade durumda RIU'dan gelen oturum emrinin yok sayılması
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, GSM-R üzerinden yalnızca tek bir iletişim oturumu işleyebilmektedir (degrade durum). Mevcut bir GSM-R oturumu aktif.
test_cases.test_inputs: RIU'dan gelen veri: Yeni bir RIU ile oturum kurma emri.

steps.action: OBU, RIU'dan gelen yeni bir RIU ile oturum kurma emrini alır.
steps.expected: OBU, emri yok sayar ve yeni bir oturum başlatmaz.

test_cases.title: Infill alanına girişte RIU'ya bilgi gönderilmesi
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, RIU ile aktif bir oturuma sahiptir. Balise grubundan infill alanına giriş emri alınmıştır.
test_cases.test_inputs: Balise grubu verisi: Infill alanı konumu.

steps.action: OBU, balise grubu emrinde belirtilen konumu geçer.
steps.expected: OBU, RIU'ya bilgi gönderir.

test_cases.title: Ana sinyal balise grubu okunduğunda RIU'ya bilgi gönderilmesi
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, RIU ile aktif bir oturuma sahiptir ve infill alanında hareket etmektedir. Balise grubu emrinde bir sonraki ana sinyal balise grubu tanımlıdır.
test_cases.test_inputs: Balise grubu verisi: Bir sonraki ana sinyal balise grubu kimliği.

steps.action: OBU, emirde belirtilen bir sonraki ana sinyal balise grubunu okur.
steps.expected: OBU, RIU'ya bilgi gönderir.

test_cases.title: Ana sinyal balise grubu kaçırıldığında RIU'ya bilgi gönderilmesi
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, RIU ile aktif bir oturuma sahiptir ve infill alanında hareket etmektedir. Balise grubu emrinde bir sonraki ana sinyal balise grubu tanımlıdır.

steps.action: Gönderilen veri paketi incelenir.

test_cases.title: Emergency stop active: New movement authority is rejected
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in a state where it has accepted an emergency stop message and the emergency stop has not yet been revoked.
test_cases.test_inputs: A valid new movement authority (MA) message.

steps.action: Send a new movement authority message to the OBU.
steps.expected: The OBU rejects the new movement authority.

steps.action: Check the OBU status regarding the active movement authority.
steps.expected: The OBU does not apply the new movement authority and maintains the emergency stop state.

test_cases.title: Emergency stop revoked: New movement authority is accepted
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU has accepted an emergency stop message. The emergency stop is subsequently revoked.
test_cases.test_inputs: A valid new movement authority (MA) message sent after the revocation.

steps.action: Send a revocation message for the emergency stop to the OBU.
steps.expected: The OBU accepts the revocation and clears the emergency stop state.

steps.action: Send a new movement authority message to the OBU.
steps.expected: The OBU accepts the new movement authority.

test_cases.title: Emergency stop active: Invalid movement authority is rejected
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in a state where it has accepted an emergency stop message and the emergency stop has not yet been revoked.
test_cases.test_inputs: An invalid or malformed movement authority message.

steps.action: Send an invalid movement authority message to the OBU.
steps.expected: The OBU rejects the message.

steps.action: Verify the OBU state.
steps.expected: The OBU remains in the emergency stop state and does not apply any movement authority.

test_cases.title: Emergency message revocation acknowledgement
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in operational mode and has previously received and acknowledged an emergency message. The RBC is configured to send a revocation for this specific emergency message.
test_cases.test_inputs: Emergency Message Revocation message from RBC.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU is connected to the RBC via a valid GSM-R or ETCS link. The specific emergency message ID is known to the OBU.

steps.action: Send an Emergency Message Revocation message from the RBC to the OBU containing the ID of the previously acknowledged emergency message.
steps.expected: The OBU receives the revocation message and processes it according to SUBSET-026 §3.16.3.5.

steps.action: Monitor the OBU's response to the RBC.
steps.expected: The OBU sends an acknowledgement message to the RBC confirming the receipt and processing of the revocation.

steps.action: Check the OBU's internal state regarding the emergency message.
steps.expected: The emergency message is no longer active or displayed as an active alert in the OBU's internal state.

test_cases.title: On-Sight modunda ray kenarı hız limitinin ulusal ve varsayılan değerlere önceliği

test_cases.title: PBD verisi alındığında hız kısıtlamasının hesaplanması
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, ray kenarı (trackside) ile iletişim halindedir ve geçerli bir PBD (Permitted Braking Distance) verisi seti mevcuttur.
test_cases.test_inputs: Geçerli PBD verisi (SUBSET-026 §3.11.11'e uygun).
test_cases.assumptions: OBU'nun iç saat ve sensör verileri stabil ve tutarlıdır.

steps.action: Ray kenarından geçerli bir PBD verisi seti gönderilir.
steps.expected: OBU, gelen veriyi işler ve PBD'yi sağlamak için gerekli hız kısıtlamasını hesaplar.

steps.action: Hesaplanan hız kısıtlaması değeri gözlemlenir.
steps.expected: Hesaplanan hız kısıtlaması, SUBSET-026 §3.11.11.4'te belirtilen varsayımlara göre tutarlı bir değerdir ve OBU bu değeri uygulayacak duruma geçer.

test_cases.title: Girdi değişmediğinde yeniden hesaplamanın yapılmaması
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, PBD verisi alarak bir hız kısıtlaması hesaplamıştır ve sistem stabil bir durumdadır.
test_cases.test_inputs: Değişmeyen PBD girdi seti.
test_cases.assumptions: Hesaplama için kullanılan diğer girdiler (hız, eğim vb.) sabit tutulur.

steps.action: Hesaplama için kullanılan girdilerden hiçbiri değişmeden, aynı PBD verisi seti tekrar işlenir veya sistem bekletilir.
steps.expected: OBU, hız kısıtlamasını yeniden hesaplamaz (hesaplama işlemi tetiklenmez).

steps.action: Mevcut hız kısıtlaması değeri kontrol edilir.
steps.expected: Hız kısıtlaması değeri, önceki hesaplamayla aynı kalır.

test_cases.title: Girdi değiştiğinde yeniden hesaplamanın yapılması
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, PBD verisi alarak bir hız kısıtlaması hesaplamıştır.
test_cases.test_inputs: Değiştirilmiş PBD verisi veya ilgili girdi (örneğin eğim veya frenleme parametresi).
test_cases.assumptions: Değişen girdi, SUBSET-026 §3.11.11'de tanımlanan hesaplama girdileri arasındadır.

steps.action: Hesaplama için kullanılan girdilerden biri (örneğin PBD mesafesi veya eğim) değiştirilir.
steps.expected: OBU, girdi değişikliğini algılar ve hız kısıtlamasını yeniden hesaplamayı tetikler.

steps.action: Yeni hesaplanan hız kısıtlaması değeri gözlemlenir.
steps.expected: Hız kısıtlaması, yeni girdi değerlerine göre güncellenmiş ve farklı bir değer alır.

test_cases.title: Hesaplama varsayımlarının (EBD/SBD, sıfır ivme, sabit gecikme) uygulanması
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, PBD hesaplama modundadır ve SUBSET-026 §3.11.11.4 varsayımları etkinleştirilmiştir.
test_cases.test_inputs: Bilinen PBD mesafesi ve araç parametreleri.
test_cases.assumptions: Hesaplama motoru, dönen kütle telafili eğimi, güvenli frenleme varsayımlarını ve sabit hız hatası/geri besleme gecikmesini kullanmaktadır.

steps.action: Belirli bir PBD mesafesi ve araç durumu için hız kısıtlaması hesaplaması yapılır.
steps.expected: Hesaplama, EBD eğrisinin (ve hizmet freni PBD için SBD eğrisinin) izin verilen frenleme mesafesinde sıfır hıza ulaştığı varsayımını kullanır.

steps.action: Hesaplama çıktısı, bağımsız bir referans modelle (SUBSET-026 §3.11.11.4'e göre) karşılaştırılır.
steps.expected: OBU'nun hesapladığı hız kısıtlaması, sıfır tahmini ivme ve sabit işleme/frenleme gecikme varsayımlarını içeren referans modelle eşleşir.

test_cases.title: Acil fren (EBD) tabanlı PBD hız kısıtlamasının hesaplanması
test_cases.preconditions: Ray kenarı, PBD'nin acil fren (EBD) kullanılarak sağlanmasını gerektirmektedir.
test_cases.test_inputs: EBD tabanlı PBD verisi.
test_cases.assumptions: SUBSET-026 §3.11.11.6'daki eşitsizlikler ve yuvarlatma kuralları bilinmektedir.

steps.action: EBD tabanlı PBD verisi OBU'ya gönderilir.
steps.expected: OBU, SUBSET-026 §3.11.11.6'daki EBD tabanlı eşitsizlikleri sağlayan hızı hesaplar.

steps.action: Hesaplanan hız değeri kontrol edilir.
steps.expected: Hız değeri, eşitsizlikleri sağlayan en yüksek hızdır ve SUBSET-026 §3.11.11.6'da belirtildiği gibi aşağı yuvarlatılmıştır.

test_cases.title: Hiçbir hızın eşitsizlikleri sağlamadığında hızın sıfır olması
test_cases.preconditions: Ray kenarı, PBD'nin acil fren (EBD) kullanılarak sağlanmasını gerektirmektedir.
test_cases.test_inputs: Çok kısa PBD mesafesi veya yüksek başlangıç hızı gibi, EBD tabanlı eşitsizlikleri hiçbir pozitif hızın sağlayamayacağı bir senaryo.
test_cases.assumptions: Girdi verileri, fiziksel olarak frenlemenin imkansız olduğu veya mevcut hızın çok yüksek olduğu bir durumu temsil etmektedir.

steps.action: EBD tabanlı eşitsizlikleri hiçbir pozitif hızın sağlayamayacağı PBD verisi OBU'ya gönderilir.
steps.expected: OBU, hesaplama yapar ve eşitsizlikleri sağlayan bir hız bulunamadığını belirler.

steps.action: Hesaplanan PBD hız kısıtlaması değeri gözlemlenir.
steps.expected: Hız kısıtlaması değeri 0 (sıfır) olarak ayarlanır.

test_cases.title: Tunnel stopping area start evaluation with estimated front end
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in operational mode. A tunnel stopping area is defined in the track database. The train is approaching the tunnel stopping area.
test_cases.test_inputs: Train position data such that the estimated front end is just before the start of the tunnel stopping area.
test_cases.assumptions: The estimated front end position is calculated correctly by the OBU based on train length and current position.

steps.action: Move the train so that the estimated front end is 10 meters before the start of the tunnel stopping area.
steps.expected: The OBU does not trigger the tunnel stopping area condition.

steps.action: Move the train so that the estimated front end is exactly at the start of the tunnel stopping area.
steps.expected: The OBU evaluates the start of the tunnel stopping area as active.

steps.action: Move the train so that the estimated front end is 10 meters inside the tunnel stopping area.
steps.expected: The OBU continues to evaluate the tunnel stopping area as active.

test_cases.title: Tunnel stopping area end evaluation with estimated front end
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in operational mode. The train is currently inside a tunnel stopping area.
test_cases.test_inputs: Train position data such that the estimated front end is approaching the end of the tunnel stopping area.
test_cases.assumptions: The estimated front end position is calculated correctly by the OBU based on train length and current position.

steps.action: Move the train so that the estimated front end is 10 meters before the end of the tunnel stopping area.
steps.expected: The OBU continues to evaluate the tunnel stopping area as active.

steps.action: Move the train so that the estimated front end is exactly at the end of the tunnel stopping area.
steps.expected: The OBU evaluates the end of the tunnel stopping area, deactivating the condition.

steps.action: Move the train so that the estimated front end is 10 meters after the end of the tunnel stopping area.
steps.expected: The OBU does not evaluate the tunnel stopping area as active.

test_cases.title: Boundary condition: Estimated front end exactly at start of tunnel stopping area

test_cases.title: Loading gauge unsuitability detection
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is powered on and Train Data is stored with a specific loading gauge (e.g., Gauge A). Trackside sends route suitability data permitting only Gauge B.
test_cases.test_inputs: Route suitability data: Permitted Gauges = [Gauge B]. Stored Train Data: Loading Gauge = Gauge A.

steps.action: Send route suitability data from trackside to the OBU.
steps.expected: OBU receives the data and initiates comparison with stored Train Data.

steps.action: Observe the OBU's suitability status.
steps.expected: OBU reports an unsuitability due to loading gauge mismatch.

test_cases.title: Axle load category unsuitability detection
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is powered on and Train Data is stored with a specific axle load category (e.g., Category 1). Trackside sends route suitability data permitting only Category 2.
test_cases.test_inputs: Route suitability data: Permitted Axle Load Categories = [Category 2]. Stored Train Data: Axle Load Category = Category 1.

steps.action: Send route suitability data from trackside to the OBU.
steps.expected: OBU receives the data and initiates comparison with stored Train Data.

steps.action: Observe the OBU's suitability status.

test_cases.title: Traction system unsuitability detection

test_cases.test_inputs: Route suitability data: Traction System = Y. Stored Train Data: Accepted Traction Systems = [X].

steps.action: Send route suitability data from trackside to the OBU.
steps.expected: OBU receives the data and initiates comparison with stored Train Data.

steps.action: Observe the OBU's suitability status.
steps.expected: OBU reports an unsuitability due to traction system mismatch.

test_cases.title: Suitability confirmation when all parameters match
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is powered on and Train Data is stored with Loading Gauge A, Axle Load Category 1, and Accepted Traction System X. Trackside sends route suitability data permitting Gauge A, Category 1, and Traction System X.
test_cases.test_inputs: Route suitability data: Permitted Gauges = [A], Permitted Axle Load Categories = [1], Traction System = X. Stored Train Data: Loading Gauge = A, Axle Load Category = 1, Accepted Traction Systems = [X].

steps.action: Send route suitability data from trackside to the OBU.

steps.action: Observe the OBU's suitability status.

steps.action: Observe the OBU's suitability status regarding traction.

steps.expected: OBU allows the train to run.

steps.expected: OBU does not use or supervise any default route suitability values.

steps.action: Check the OBU's initial state regarding route suitability restrictions.
steps.expected: OBU indicates that no route suitability restriction exists.

test_cases.title: Display appearance for auxiliary information without acknowledgement

test_cases.test_inputs: Text message with class 'auxiliary information' and 'acknowledgement not requested'.

steps.expected: The OBU displays the message using the appearance defined for auxiliary information without acknowledgement.

test_cases.title: Display appearance for important information with acknowledgement

test_cases.test_inputs: Text message with class 'important information' and 'acknowledgement requested'.
test_cases.assumptions: The specific visual appearance (e.g., font, color, position) for this combination is defined in the OBU HMI specification.

steps.action: Send a text message from trackside with class 'important information' and acknowledgement flag set to 'requested'.
steps.expected: The OBU displays the message using the appearance defined for important information with acknowledgement.

test_cases.title: Start condition with multiple sub-conditions (OR logic)
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in operational mode.
test_cases.test_inputs: Text message with start condition defined as 'Location A OR Speed > 50 km/h'.
test_cases.assumptions: Trackside defines the logic as 'any one fulfilled' (OR).

steps.action: Move the train to Location A while speed is below 50 km/h.
steps.expected: The start condition is considered fulfilled and the message display logic initiates.

test_cases.title: Start condition with multiple sub-conditions (AND logic)
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in operational mode.
test_cases.test_inputs: Text message with start condition defined as 'Location A AND Speed > 50 km/h'.
test_cases.assumptions: Trackside defines the logic as 'all fulfilled' (AND).

steps.action: Move the train to Location A while speed is below 50 km/h.
steps.expected: The start condition is NOT fulfilled.

steps.action: Increase speed to above 50 km/h while at Location A.
steps.expected: The start condition is considered fulfilled.

test_cases.title: Start condition fulfilled immediately when no sub-conditions defined
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in operational mode.
test_cases.test_inputs: Text message with no start sub-conditions defined.

steps.action: Receive a text message that defines none of the start sub-conditions.
steps.expected: The OBU treats the start condition as fulfilled immediately upon receipt.

test_cases.title: Driver acknowledgement ends display regardless of end condition
test_cases.preconditions: A text message requesting driver confirmation is displayed. The message defines acknowledgement as 'always ending display'. The end condition (e.g., location) is not yet fulfilled.
test_cases.test_inputs: Driver acknowledgement input.

steps.action: Driver acknowledges the message.
steps.expected: The text display ends immediately, even though the end condition is not fulfilled.

test_cases.title: Driver acknowledgement is necessary but not sufficient for ending display
test_cases.preconditions: A text message requesting driver confirmation is displayed. The message defines acknowledgement as 'necessary condition in addition to end condition'. The end condition is not yet fulfilled.
test_cases.test_inputs: Driver acknowledgement input.

steps.action: Driver acknowledges the message.
steps.expected: The text display continues because the end condition is not yet fulfilled.

steps.action: Fulfil the end condition (e.g., pass the defined location).
steps.expected: The text display ends.

test_cases.title: Message not displayed if end condition already fulfilled at start
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in operational mode.
test_cases.test_inputs: Text message where the end condition is already fulfilled at the moment the start condition is met.

steps.action: Configure a message such that its end condition is already true when the start condition becomes true.
steps.expected: The OBU does not display the message at all.

test_cases.title: Display length measured from start location regardless of other start conditions
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in operational mode.
test_cases.test_inputs: Text message with start condition 'Location A AND Speed > 50 km/h' and end condition 'Location B' (where B is 100m after A).

steps.action: Fulfil the start condition at Location A.
steps.expected: The OBU starts measuring the display length from Location A.

steps.action: Move the train to Location B.
steps.expected: The end condition is fulfilled and the display ends, confirming the length was measured from Location A.

test_cases.title: Send driver acknowledgement report to RBC

steps.expected: The report includes the text message identifier.

test_cases.title: Reject new text message with duplicate identifier of unacknowledged message

steps.expected: The OBU rejects the newly received text message.

test_cases.title: Infill MA ile SH Mode Profile'ın başlangıcının referans noktasında veya gerisinde olması durumunda silinmesi
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, izlenen (supervised) bir SH Mode Profile'ı işlemektedir. Infill MA, referans konumu SH Mode Profile'ın başlangıcında veya gerisinde olacak şekilde hazırlanmıştır.

steps.expected: OBU, izlenen SH Mode Profile'ı tamamen siler.

test_cases.title: Infill MA ile SH Mode Profile'ın başlangıcının referans noktasından öte olması durumunda korunması
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, izlenen (supervised) bir SH Mode Profile'ı işlemektedir. Infill MA, referans konumu SH Mode Profile'ın başlangıcından öte olacak şekilde hazırlanmıştır.
test_cases.test_inputs: Infill MA: Referans konumu > SH Mode Profile başlangıcı. Infill MA içinde yeni Mode Profile ve SH balise group listesi mevcut.

test_cases.title: Mode Profile başlangıcında geçici EOA ve SvL (release speed olmadan) uygulaması - Profil SvL gerektiriyorsa
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, Mode Profile'a geçiş yapmamıştır. Mode Profile başlangıcı yaklaşmaktadır. Profil, başlangıçta SvL (Stop with Limit) gerektirmektedir.
test_cases.test_inputs: Mode Profile: Başlangıçta SvL gerektiren profil. MA: LOA bilgisi mevcut veya yok (profil gereksinimi önceliklidir).
test_cases.assumptions: OBU'nun hızı ve konumu, Mode Profile başlangıcına yaklaşacak şekilde ayarlanmıştır.

steps.action: OBU, Mode Profile başlangıcına yaklaşırken profilin SvL gerektirdiği durum simüle edilir.
steps.expected: OBU, Mode Profile başlangıcını geçici EOA (End of Authority) olarak ele alır.

steps.action: OBU'nun hız profili kontrol edilir.
steps.expected: OBU, Mode Profile başlangıcında release speed olmadan SvL (Stop with Limit) uygular.

test_cases.title: Mode Profile başlangıcında geçici EOA ve SvL (release speed olmadan) uygulaması - Profil SvL gerektirmiyorsa ve MA'da LOA varsa (LOA profil başlangıcında veya ötesinde)
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, Mode Profile'a geçiş yapmamıştır. Mode Profile başlangıcı yaklaşmaktadır. Profil, başlangıçta SvL gerektirmemektedir. MA'da LOA (Limit of Authority) bilgisi mevcuttur ve LOA, Mode Profile başlangıcında veya ötesindedir.

steps.action: OBU'nun hız profili kontrol edilir.
steps.expected: OBU, LOA verilmemiş gibi davranarak (LOA at or beyond the profile start) Mode Profile başlangıcında release speed olmadan SvL uygular.

test_cases.title: Mode Profile başlangıcında geçici EOA ve SvL (release speed olmadan) uygulaması - Profil SvL gerektirmiyorsa ve MA'da LOA varsa (LOA profil başlangıcının gerisinde)
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, Mode Profile'a geçiş yapmamıştır. Mode Profile başlangıcı yaklaşmaktadır. Profil, başlangıçta SvL gerektirmemektedir. MA'da LOA (Limit of Authority) bilgisi mevcuttur ve LOA, Mode Profile başlangıcının gerisindedir.
test_cases.test_inputs: Mode Profile: Başlangıçta SvL gerektirmeyen profil. MA: LOA < Mode Profile başlangıcı.
test_cases.assumptions: SUBSET-026 §3.8.4.5 kuralları test ortamında uygulanmaktadır.

steps.action: OBU, Mode Profile başlangıcına yaklaşırken profilin SvL gerektirmediği ve LOA'nın profil başlangıcının gerisinde olduğu durum simüle edilir.
steps.expected: OBU, Mode Profile başlangıcını geçici EOA olarak ele alır.

steps.action: OBU'nun hız profili kontrol edilir.
steps.expected: OBU, Mode Profile başlangıcında release speed olmadan SvL uygular (LOA in rear of it).

test_cases.title: LX information replacement with same identity
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is powered on and in a state where it can receive LX information. An initial LX information packet with Identity ID 'ID-123' and Data 'Data-A' is already stored in the OBU.
test_cases.test_inputs: New LX information packet with Identity ID 'ID-123' and Data 'Data-B'.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU provides a diagnostic interface or log to verify the stored LX information content.

steps.action: Verify the currently stored LX information for Identity ID 'ID-123'.
steps.expected: The stored data is 'Data-A'.

steps.action: Transmit the new LX information packet with Identity ID 'ID-123' and Data 'Data-B' to the OBU.
steps.expected: The OBU accepts the new LX information.

steps.action: Read the stored LX information for Identity ID 'ID-123' from the OBU.
steps.expected: The stored data is 'Data-B', confirming the old information was replaced.

test_cases.title: LX information replacement with different identity
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is powered on. An initial LX information packet with Identity ID 'ID-123' and Data 'Data-A' is already stored in the OBU.

steps.expected: The OBU accepts the new LX information.

steps.action: Read the stored LX information for Identity ID 'ID-123' from the OBU.
steps.expected: The stored data remains 'Data-A', as the new information had a different identity.

steps.action: Read the stored LX information for Identity ID 'ID-456' from the OBU.
steps.expected: The stored data is 'Data-C'.
