test_cases.title: PBD verisi alındığında hız kısıtlamasının hesaplanması
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, ray kenarı tarafından gönderilen izin verilen frenleme mesafesi (PBD) verisini almaya hazırdır. Diğer girdiler (eğim, tren ağırlığı vb.) sabittir.
test_cases.test_inputs: Ray kenarından gelen PBD verisi paketi.
test_cases.assumptions: OBU'nun iç saat ve sensör verileri stabil çalışmaktadır.

steps.action: Ray kenarı, OBU'ya izin verilen frenleme mesafesi verisini gönderir.
steps.expected: OBU, gelen veriye dayanarak izin verilen frenleme mesafesini sağlamak için gerekli hız kısıtlamasını hesaplar ve bu kısıtlamayı aktif hale getirir.

steps.action: Hesaplanan hız kısıtlaması değeri OBU arayüzünden veya log kayıtlarından okunur.
steps.expected: Gösterilen hız kısıtlaması, SUBSET-026 §3.11.11.4'te belirtilen varsayımlara göre hesaplanan değerle eşleşir.

test_cases.title: Girdi değişmediğinde hız kısıtlamasının yeniden hesaplanmaması
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, PBD verisini almış ve hız kısıtlamasını hesaplamıştır. Tüm girdiler sabittir.
test_cases.test_inputs: Zaman geçişi (bekleme).
test_cases.assumptions: Tren hareket halindeyken veya dururken girdilerde (eğim, ağırlık, PBD) herhangi bir değişiklik olmamaktadır.

steps.action: Hesaplama girdilerinde (PBD, eğim, tren ağırlığı vb.) herhangi bir değişiklik yapılmadan belirli bir süre beklenir.
steps.expected: OBU, hız kısıtlamasını yeniden hesaplamaz; mevcut hız kısıtlaması değeri sabit kalır.

steps.action: OBU'nun hesaplama aktivite logları incelenir.
steps.expected: Bu süre zarfında yeni bir PBD hız kısıtlaması hesaplama işlemi tetiklenmediği görülür.

test_cases.title: Girdi değiştiğinde hız kısıtlamasının yeniden hesaplanması
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, PBD verisini almış ve hız kısıtlamasını hesaplamıştır.
test_cases.test_inputs: Değiştirilmiş PBD verisi veya değiştirilmiş eğim verisi.
test_cases.assumptions: Girdi değişimi, SUBSET-026 §3.11.11'de tanımlanan hesaplama girdileri kapsamındadır.

steps.action: Hesaplama girdilerinden biri (örneğin, ray kenarından gelen PBD mesafesi veya eğim verisi) değiştirilir.
steps.expected: OBU, girdi değişikliğini algılar ve hız kısıtlamasını yeniden hesaplar.

steps.action: Yeni hesaplanan hız kısıtlaması değeri okunur.
steps.expected: Gösterilen hız kısıtlaması, yeni girdi değerlerine göre güncellenmiş ve farklı bir değer alır.

test_cases.title: PBD hız kısıtlaması hesaplamasında SUBSET-026 §3.11.11.4 varsayımlarının uygulanması
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, PBD verisi almaya hazırdır. Test ortamında SUBSET-026 §3.11.11.4'te belirtilen parametreler (dönen kütle telafili eğim, güvenli frenleme ivmeleri, EBD eğrisi vb.) bilinen değerlerle sabitlenmiştir.
test_cases.test_inputs: Bilinen PBD mesafesi, bilinen eğim, bilinen tren ağırlığı.
test_cases.assumptions: Bağımsız bir referans hesaplama modeli, SUBSET-026 §3.11.11.4 varsayımlarını kullanarak beklenen hız kısıtlamasını hesaplayabilmektedir.

steps.action: OBU'ya bilinen PBD ve diğer girdiler verilir.
steps.expected: OBU, hız kısıtlamasını hesaplar.

steps.action: OBU'nun hesapladığı hız kısıtlaması, bağımsız referans modelin (SUBSET-026 §3.11.11.4 varsayımlarını kullanan) hesapladığı değerle karşılaştırılır.
steps.expected: OBU'nun sonucu, referans modelin sonucu ile eşleşir (tolerans dahilinde). Bu, dönen kütle telafili eğim, güvenli frenleme ivmeleri, EBD eğrisi, sıfır tahmini ivme ve sabit hız hatası/gecikme varsayımlarının doğru uygulandığını gösterir.

test_cases.title: Acil frenle PBD sağlandığında hız kısıtlamasının EBD eşitsizliklerine göre hesaplanması
test_cases.preconditions: Ray kenarı, PBD'nin acil fren (EBD) kullanılarak sağlanmasını gerektiren bir durum gönderir. OBU, EBD eğrisi verilerine sahiptir.
test_cases.test_inputs: EBD tabanlı PBD gereksinimi, bilinen PBD mesafesi.
test_cases.assumptions: SUBSET-026 §3.11.11.6'da tanımlanan EBD tabanlı eşitsizlikler ve yuvarlatma kuralı bilinen bir referans modelde uygulanabilir.

steps.action: OBU'ya, PBD'nin acil frenle sağlanmasını gerektiren veri paketi gönderilir.
steps.expected: OBU, SUBSET-026 §3.11.11.6'daki EBD tabanlı eşitsizlikleri sağlayan hızı hesaplar.

steps.action: Hesaplanan hız kısıtlaması değeri, referans modelin (eşitsizlikleri sağlayan ve aşağı yuvarlatılmış) değeriyle karşılaştırılır.
steps.expected: OBU'nun sonucu, referans modelin sonucu ile eşleşir. Hız değeri, eşitsizlikleri sağlayan en yüksek hızın aşağı yuvarlatılmış halidir.

test_cases.title: EBD eşitsizliklerini sağlayan hız yoksa hız kısıtlamasının sıfır olması
test_cases.preconditions: Ray kenarı, PBD'nin acil frenle sağlanmasını gerektiren bir durum gönderir. PBD mesafesi, mevcut EBD eğrisiyle hiçbir hızda sağlanamayacak kadar kısadır (örneğin, tren zaten durmuş veya çok kısa mesafe).
test_cases.test_inputs: Çok kısa PBD mesafesi, EBD eğrisi verileri.
test_cases.assumptions: Referans model, bu girdilerle EBD eşitsizliklerini sağlayan pozitif bir hız olmadığını doğrulamaktadır.

steps.action: OBU'ya, EBD eşitsizliklerini sağlayan pozitif bir hızın olmadığı bir PBD mesafesi verilir.
steps.expected: OBU, hız kısıtlamasını hesaplar.

steps.action: Hesaplanan hız kısıtlaması değeri okunur.
steps.expected: Hız kısıtlaması 0 (sıfır) olarak ayarlanır.

steps.expected: Mesaj ekranda görünür.

test_cases.title: Sürücü onayının mesajı her zaman sonlandırması
test_cases.preconditions: OBU aktif durumdadır.

steps.expected: Mesaj ekrandan kaldırılır (onay, bitiş koşulundan bağımsız olarak mesajı sonlandırır).

test_cases.title: Sürücü onayının bitiş koşuluna ek olarak gerekli olması

steps.expected: Mesaj ekranda görünür.

steps.action: Tren Konum B'ye ulaşır.

steps.expected: Mesaj ekrandan kaldırılır (hem bitiş koşulu hem onay sağlandı).

test_cases.title: Başlangıç koşulunun sağlandığı anda bitiş koşulunun da sağlanması

test_cases.title: Bitiş koşulunda konum alt koşulunun kullanılması

test_cases.preconditions: OBU'da RBC iletişim bilgileri saklanmamıştır.
test_cases.test_inputs: Rota kenarı komutu: 'Son bilinen RBC' kimliği.

steps.action: Rota kenarı, 'son bilinen RBC' kimliği ile iletişim oturumu kurma komutu gönderir.
steps.expected: OBU, komutu yok sayar.

steps.action: OBU'nun RBC'ye bağlanma denemesi gözlemlenir.
steps.expected: OBU, RBC'ye bağlanma denemesi yapmaz.

test_cases.title: Ongoing session prevents new session establishment with same RBC
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2 mode. A communication session with RBC-A is currently being established (state: Establishing).
test_cases.test_inputs: Trigger for Start of Mission in Level 2.
test_cases.assumptions: RBC-A is the target RBC for the Start of Mission.

steps.action: Initiate Start of Mission in Level 2 targeting RBC-A.
steps.expected: The OBU does not initiate a new communication session establishment procedure with RBC-A. The existing establishment process continues.

steps.action: Wait for the initial session establishment with RBC-A to complete.
steps.expected: The session with RBC-A is established successfully.

test_cases.title: Established session without termination prevents new session with same RBC
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2 mode. A communication session with RBC-A is established and active. No 'Termination of Communication Session' message has been sent to RBC-A.
test_cases.test_inputs: Manual selection of RBC contact information for RBC-A by the driver.
test_cases.assumptions: The driver manually selects RBC-A again while the session is active.

steps.action: Driver manually selects RBC-A contact information outside of Start of Mission.
steps.expected: The OBU does not attempt to open a further communication session with RBC-A. The existing session remains active.

test_cases.title: Termination of existing session when establishing new session with different RBC
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2 mode. An active communication session exists with RBC-A. The OBU is capable of handling multiple sessions (or the exception condition is not met).
test_cases.test_inputs: Order from trackside to establish a session with RBC-B.
test_cases.assumptions: RBC-B is a different RBC than RBC-A.

steps.action: Receive an order from trackside to establish a communication session with RBC-B.
steps.expected: The OBU initiates the termination of the existing session with RBC-A.

steps.action: Wait for the termination of the session with RBC-A to complete.
steps.expected: The session with RBC-A is terminated.

steps.action: Observe the OBU's action towards RBC-B.
steps.expected: The OBU establishes a new communication session with RBC-B.

test_cases.title: Exception: RBC transition order does not terminate current session if multi-session capable
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2 mode. An active communication session exists with RBC-A (currently supervising). The OBU is capable of handling more than one communication session through GSM-R.
test_cases.test_inputs: RBC transition order containing an embedded order to establish a session with Accepting RBC-B.
test_cases.assumptions: RBC-B is the Accepting RBC in the transition.

steps.action: Receive an RBC transition order from RBC-A that includes an embedded order to establish a session with RBC-B.
steps.expected: The OBU does not terminate the existing session with RBC-A.

steps.action: Observe the OBU's action towards RBC-B.
steps.expected: The OBU establishes a new communication session with RBC-B while maintaining the session with RBC-A.

test_cases.title: Exception: RBC transition order terminates current session if single-session only
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2 mode. An active communication session exists with RBC-A (currently supervising). The OBU can handle only one communication session through GSM-R.
test_cases.test_inputs: RBC transition order containing an embedded order to establish a session with Accepting RBC-B.
test_cases.assumptions: RBC-B is the Accepting RBC in the transition.

steps.action: Receive an RBC transition order from RBC-A that includes an embedded order to establish a session with RBC-B.
steps.expected: The OBU terminates the existing session with RBC-A.

steps.action: Observe the OBU's action towards RBC-B.
steps.expected: The OBU establishes a new communication session with RBC-B.

test_cases.title: Evaluation of balise information in Sleeping mode (Nominal direction)
test_cases.preconditions: Engine is in Sleeping (SL) mode. Train orientation is Nominal. A balise group is crossed in the Nominal direction.
test_cases.test_inputs: Balise group data containing: 1) Speed restriction valid for Nominal direction, 2) Speed restriction valid for Reverse direction, 3) Speed restriction valid for Both directions.
test_cases.assumptions: The balise group is crossed in the Nominal direction.

steps.action: Cross the balise group in the Nominal direction while in SL mode.
steps.expected: The OBU takes into account the speed restriction valid for the Nominal direction.

steps.action: Check the status of the speed restriction valid for the Reverse direction.
steps.expected: The OBU ignores the speed restriction valid only for the Reverse direction.

steps.action: Check the status of the speed restriction valid for Both directions.
steps.expected: The OBU takes into account the speed restriction valid for Both directions.

test_cases.title: Evaluation of balise information in Shunting mode (Reverse direction)
test_cases.preconditions: Engine is in Shunting (SH) mode. Train orientation is Nominal. A balise group is crossed in the Reverse direction.
test_cases.test_inputs: Balise group data containing: 1) Speed restriction valid for Nominal direction, 2) Speed restriction valid for Reverse direction, 3) Speed restriction valid for Both directions.
test_cases.assumptions: The balise group is crossed in the Reverse direction.

steps.action: Cross the balise group in the Reverse direction while in SH mode.
steps.expected: The OBU takes into account the speed restriction valid for the Reverse direction.

steps.action: Check the status of the speed restriction valid for the Nominal direction.
steps.expected: The OBU ignores the speed restriction valid only for the Nominal direction.

steps.action: Check the status of the speed restriction valid for Both directions.
steps.expected: The OBU takes into account the speed restriction valid for Both directions.

test_cases.title: MA request parameters persistence and immediate request on new parameter receipt
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2 mode. Current MA request parameters: Repetition = Yes, Period = 10s. Time since last MA request = 12s.
test_cases.test_inputs: New MA request parameters from RBC: Repetition = Yes, Period = 5s.
test_cases.assumptions: The new parameters are received at the moment when the time since the last MA request (12s) is greater than the new period (5s).

steps.action: Receive new MA request parameters from the RBC specifying a repetition period of 5s.
steps.expected: The OBU replaces the old parameters with the new ones immediately.

steps.action: Observe the OBU's action immediately after receiving the new parameters.
steps.expected: The OBU sends an MA request immediately because the time since the last request (12s) is higher than the new repetition period (5s).

test_cases.title: MA request parameters persistence without immediate request if time is less than new period
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2 mode. Current MA request parameters: Repetition = Yes, Period = 10s. Time since last MA request = 2s.
test_cases.test_inputs: New MA request parameters from RBC: Repetition = Yes, Period = 5s.
test_cases.assumptions: The new parameters are received at the moment when the time since the last MA request (2s) is less than the new period (5s).

steps.action: Receive new MA request parameters from the RBC specifying a repetition period of 5s.
steps.expected: The OBU replaces the old parameters with the new ones immediately.

steps.action: Observe the OBU's action immediately after receiving the new parameters.
steps.expected: The OBU does not send an MA request immediately. It waits for the new repetition period to elapse from the last request.

test_cases.title: No Supervised Location defined while supervising Limit of Authority
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is supervising a Limit of Authority (LoA) with a target speed above zero. The train is approaching the end of the overlap which is a candidate for Supervised Location (SvL).
test_cases.test_inputs: Train movement towards the end of the overlap.
test_cases.assumptions: The end of the overlap is within the supervised LoA.

steps.action: Move the train towards the end of the overlap while the LoA is being supervised.
steps.expected: The OBU does not define the end of the overlap as a Supervised Location (SvL).

steps.action: Check the list of active Supervised Locations on the OBU.
steps.expected: None of the SvL candidates (end of overlap, Danger Point, end of End Section) are active as SvL.

test_cases.title: Level 1 speed restriction remains valid until new restriction received
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 1 mode. A Level 1 signalling related speed restriction of 80 km/h is active.
test_cases.test_inputs: No new speed restriction received for a duration of 10 minutes.
test_cases.assumptions: The train is moving in Level 1 mode.

steps.action: Wait for 10 minutes without receiving any new signalling related speed restriction.
steps.expected: The OBU continues to apply the 80 km/h speed restriction.

test_cases.title: Level 1 speed restriction replaced by new restriction
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 1 mode. A Level 1 signalling related speed restriction of 80 km/h is active.
test_cases.test_inputs: New Level 1 signalling related speed restriction of 60 km/h received.
test_cases.assumptions: The new restriction is received directly from a balise.

steps.action: Receive a new Level 1 signalling related speed restriction of 60 km/h.
steps.expected: The OBU replaces the 80 km/h restriction with the 60 km/h restriction immediately upon receipt.

test_cases.title: Level 1 speed restriction remains valid after switch to Level 2 until MA accepted
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 1 mode. A Level 1 signalling related speed restriction of 80 km/h is active. The OBU switches to Level 2 mode.
test_cases.test_inputs: Switch to Level 2 mode. No Level 2 MA accepted yet.
test_cases.assumptions: The switch to Level 2 is initiated by the driver or trackside.

steps.action: Switch the OBU from Level 1 to Level 2 mode.
steps.expected: The OBU remains in Level 2 mode.

steps.action: Check the active speed restrictions before a Level 2 MA is accepted.
steps.expected: The Level 1 signalling related speed restriction of 80 km/h remains valid and is applied.

test_cases.title: Maximum Train Speed defined as Static Speed Restriction
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is configured with a specific train performance profile.
test_cases.test_inputs: Maximum Train Speed value set to 200 km/h.
test_cases.assumptions: The train's actual performance allows 200 km/h.

steps.action: Set the Maximum Train Speed to 200 km/h in the OBU configuration.
steps.expected: The OBU accepts the value.

steps.action: Check how the OBU handles the 200 km/h value in its speed restriction logic.
steps.expected: The OBU treats the 200 km/h value as the Maximum Train Speed category of Static Speed Restriction.

test_cases.title: Initial state 'no speed restriction' for permitted braking distance
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is powered on and in a state where no trackside data for speed restrictions has been received yet.
test_cases.test_inputs: None (initial state).
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU is in a mode where permitted braking distance limits are applicable.

steps.action: Check the speed restriction status for permitted braking distance before any trackside data is received.
steps.expected: The OBU uses 'no speed restriction' as the initial state. No permitted-braking-distance limit constrains the train speed.

test_cases.title: Resumption of initial state 'no speed restriction' on trackside order
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2 mode. A speed restriction for permitted braking distance is currently active (e.g., 100 km/h).
test_cases.test_inputs: Trackside order to resume the initial state for speed restrictions.
test_cases.assumptions: The trackside sends a specific message or data element ordering the resumption of the initial state.

steps.action: Receive a trackside order to resume the initial state for speed restrictions.
steps.expected: The OBU clears the active speed restriction for permitted braking distance.

steps.action: Check the speed restriction status for permitted braking distance after the order.
steps.expected: The OBU uses 'no speed restriction' as the state. No permitted-braking-distance limit constrains the train speed.

test_cases.title: Safe radio connection loss triggers immediate reconnection attempt
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in operational mode. A safe radio connection is established with a specific radio system (e.g., GSM-R). EURORADIO is active.
test_cases.test_inputs: Simulated loss of safe radio connection signal from EURORADIO.
test_cases.assumptions: The radio system previously used for the successful connection is available and functional.

steps.action: Establish a safe radio connection between OBU and the radio system.
steps.expected: OBU status indicates an active safe radio connection.

steps.action: Simulate the loss of the safe radio connection via EURORADIO.
steps.expected: OBU immediately initiates an attempt to set up a new safe radio connection with the same radio system.

test_cases.title: Repeated reconnection attempts until success
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in operational mode. A communication session is established. Safe radio connection is lost.
test_cases.test_inputs: Simulated radio interference preventing reconnection for a short duration, followed by restoration of radio availability.
test_cases.assumptions: The communication session is not terminated and the train has not passed the RIU termination location.

steps.action: Cause the loss of the safe radio connection during an active session.
steps.expected: OBU starts repeating attempts to set up a new safe radio connection.

steps.action: Keep the radio system unavailable for a defined period (e.g., 10 seconds) to force failed reconnection attempts.
steps.expected: OBU continues to repeat reconnection attempts without stopping.

steps.action: Restore radio system availability.
steps.expected: OBU successfully establishes a new safe radio connection and stops repeating attempts.

test_cases.title: Reconnection attempts stop when session is terminated
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in operational mode. A communication session is established. Safe radio connection is lost.
test_cases.test_inputs: Command to terminate the communication session.
test_cases.assumptions: The train has not passed the RIU termination location.

steps.action: Cause the loss of the safe radio connection during an active session.
steps.expected: OBU starts repeating attempts to set up a new safe radio connection.

steps.action: Issue a command to terminate the communication session.
steps.expected: OBU stops repeating reconnection attempts and regards the session as terminated.

test_cases.title: Reconnection attempts stop when train passes RIU termination location
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in operational mode. A communication session is established with an RIU order specifying a termination location. Safe radio connection is lost.
test_cases.test_inputs: Train movement data simulating passage of the RIU termination location.
test_cases.assumptions: The communication session is not otherwise terminated.

steps.action: Cause the loss of the safe radio connection during an active session.
steps.expected: OBU starts repeating attempts to set up a new safe radio connection.

steps.action: Simulate the train passing the location given in the RIU order to terminate the communication session.
steps.expected: OBU stops repeating reconnection attempts.

test_cases.title: OBU initiates termination upon trackside order
test_cases.preconditions: An active communication session is established between the OBU and the trackside (RBC).
test_cases.test_inputs: Trackside sends a 'Termination of Communication Session' order.

steps.action: The trackside sends a termination order to the OBU.
steps.expected: The OBU initiates the termination of the communication session.

test_cases.title: OBU does not initiate termination without trackside order or condition
test_cases.preconditions: An active communication session is established. No termination conditions from SUBSET-026 are fulfilled.
test_cases.test_inputs: No trackside order is sent. No termination condition is triggered.

steps.action: Wait for a duration longer than the fixed waiting time without any trackside order or termination condition.
steps.expected: The OBU does not initiate the termination of the communication session.

test_cases.title: OBU repeats termination message if no acknowledgement is received
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU has initiated the termination of the communication session and sent the 'Termination of Communication Session' message.
test_cases.test_inputs: No acknowledgement is received from the trackside within the fixed waiting time.
test_cases.assumptions: The fixed waiting time is defined in SUBSET-026 Appendix A.3.1.

steps.action: The OBU sends the 'Termination of Communication Session' message.
steps.expected: The message is transmitted.

steps.action: Wait for the fixed waiting time without receiving an acknowledgement.
steps.expected: The OBU repeats the 'Termination of Communication Session' message.

test_cases.title: OBU considers session terminated after maximum repetitions without acknowledgement
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in the process of terminating the communication session and has been repeating the termination message.
test_cases.test_inputs: No acknowledgement is received after the last allowed repetition.
test_cases.assumptions: The defined number of repetitions is as per SUBSET-026 Appendix A.3.1.

steps.action: The OBU sends the 'Termination of Communication Session' message for the defined maximum number of times.
steps.expected: The message is sent the last time.

steps.action: Wait for the fixed waiting time after the last sending without receiving an acknowledgement.
steps.expected: The OBU considers the communication session terminated.

test_cases.title: Güç açıldığında GSM-R kayıt talebinin gönderilmesi
test_cases.preconditions: OBU kapalı durumdadır. GSM-R Mobil Terminal bağlıdır ve çalışır durumdadır.
test_cases.assumptions: GSM-R ağının mevcut olduğu varsayılır.

steps.action: OBU güç açma komutu verilir.
steps.expected: OBU, bağlı GSM-R Mobil Terminal(ler) için GSM-R Radyo Ağına kayıt talebi gönderir.

test_cases.title: Sürücü yeni GSM-R Radyo Ağı kimliği girdiğinde kayıt talebinin gönderilmesi
test_cases.preconditions: OBU çalışır durumdadır. GSM-R Mobil Terminal bağlıdır. Mevcut kayıt farklı bir ağ kimliği içindir.
test_cases.test_inputs: Yeni GSM-R Radyo Ağı kimliği (PLMN ID).

steps.action: Sürücü arayüzünden yeni bir GSM-R Radyo Ağı kimliği girilir.
steps.expected: OBU, yeni kimlik için GSM-R Radyo Ağına kayıt talebi gönderir.

test_cases.title: Ray kenarı komutuyla GSM-R kayıt talebinin gönderilmesi
test_cases.preconditions: OBU çalışır durumdadır. GSM-R Mobil Terminal bağlıdır.
test_cases.test_inputs: Ray kenarından gelen kayıt komutu mesajı.

steps.action: Ray kenarından GSM-R kayıt komutu gönderilir.
steps.expected: OBU, bağlı GSM-R Mobil Terminal(ler) için GSM-R Radyo Ağına kayıt talebi gönderir.

test_cases.title: Radyo Ağı tipi hatırlanmadığında varsayılan tipin kullanılması
test_cases.preconditions: OBU'da hatırlanmış Radyo Ağı tipi yoktur (ilk güç açma veya Sistem Arızası sonrası). Varsayılan Radyo Ağı tipi yapılandırılmıştır.
test_cases.assumptions: Varsayılan Radyo Ağı tipi 'GSM-R' olarak yapılandırılmıştır.

steps.action: OBU güç açılır ve Radyo Ağı tipi sorgulanır.
steps.expected: OBU, yapılandırılmış varsayılan Radyo Ağı tipini kullanır.

test_cases.title: Gerekli radyo sistemi kayıtlı değilken RBC oturumu için güvenli bağlantı talebinin gönderilmemesi
test_cases.preconditions: OBU çalışır durumdadır. Depolanan Radyo Ağı tipi gerektirdiği radyo sistemi (ör. GSM-R) kayıtlı değildir.
test_cases.test_inputs: Ray kenarından gelen RBC oturumu kurma komutu.
test_cases.assumptions: GSM-R terminali kayıtlı değildir.

steps.action: Ray kenarından RBC ile oturum kurma komutu gönderilir.
steps.expected: OBU, güvenli radyo bağlantısı kurulumu talebinde bulunmaz.

test_cases.title: GSM-R terminali kayıtlı değilken RIU oturumu için güvenli bağlantı talebinin gönderilmemesi
test_cases.preconditions: OBU çalışır durumdadır. Hiçbir GSM-R Mobil Terminal, bir GSM-R Radyo Ağına düzgün şekilde kayıtlı değildir.
test_cases.test_inputs: Ray kenarından gelen RIU ile iletişim oturumu kurma komutu.

steps.action: Ray kenarından RIU ile iletişim oturumu kurma komutu gönderilir.
steps.expected: OBU, güvenli radyo bağlantısı kurulumu talebinde bulunmaz.

test_cases.title: Güvenli radyo bağlantısı kurulduğunda sürücüye 'Connection Up' durumunun gösterilmesi
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, ilgili RBC/RIU ile güvenli radyo bağlantısı kurma sürecini başarıyla tamamlamıştır.
test_cases.assumptions: Sürücü arayüzünde bağlantı durumu göstergesi aktif ve okunabilir durumdadır.

steps.action: OBU'nun sürücü arayüzündeki güvenli radyo bağlantı durumu göstergesi gözlemlenir.
steps.expected: Göstergede 'Connection Up' durumu görünür.

test_cases.title: Bağlantı yokken sürücüye 'No Connection' durumunun gösterilmesi
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, herhangi bir RBC/RIU ile güvenli radyo bağlantısı kurmamıştır.
test_cases.assumptions: Sürücü arayüzünde bağlantı durumu göstergesi aktif ve okunabilir durumdadır.

steps.action: OBU'nun sürücü arayüzündeki güvenli radyo bağlantı durumu göstergesi gözlemlenir.
steps.expected: Göstergede 'No Connection' durumu görünür.

test_cases.title: Bağlantı kurulurken hata oluştuğunda sürücüye 'Connection Lost/Set-Up failed' durumunun gösterilmesi
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, RBC/RIU ile güvenli radyo bağlantısı kurma denemesi yapmaktadır ancak bu deneme başarısız olmuştur.
test_cases.assumptions: Sürücü arayüzünde bağlantı durumu göstergesi aktif ve okunabilir durumdadır.

steps.action: OBU'nun sürücü arayüzündeki güvenli radyo bağlantı durumu göstergesi gözlemlenir.
steps.expected: Göstergede 'Connection Lost/Set-Up failed' durumu görünür.

test_cases.title: Oturum kurulumu için ilk istek gönderildiğinde bağlantı durumu zamanlayıcısının başlatılması
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, 'No Connection' durumundadır ve ilgili RBC/RIU ile oturum kurmak için hazırdır.
test_cases.assumptions: OBU'nun iç zamanlayıcı durumu izlenebilir veya loglanabilir.

steps.action: OBU, SUBSET-026 §3.5.3.4) b) ila e) tetikleyicilerinden biriyle ilgili RBC/RIU'ya ilk güvenli radyo bağlantısı kurma isteğini gönderir.
steps.expected: OBU'nun bağlantı durumu zamanlayıcısının başlatıldığı gözlemlenir.

test_cases.title: Oturum sürdürme için ilk istek gönderildiğinde bağlantı durumu zamanlayıcısının başlatılması
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, mevcut bir oturumu sürdürmek için SUBSET-026 §3.5.4.2 veya §3.5.4.4 koşullarını tetiklemiştir ve henüz bu amaçla bir istek göndermemiştir.
test_cases.assumptions: OBU'nun iç zamanlayıcı durumu izlenebilir veya loglanabilir.

steps.action: OBU, oturumu sürdürmek için ilgili RBC/RIU'ya ilk güvenli radyo bağlantısı isteğini gönderir.
steps.expected: OBU'nun bağlantı durumu zamanlayıcısının başlatıldığı gözlemlenir.

test_cases.title: Bağlantı durumunun 'No Connection' dan 'Connection Up' a geçişinin SUBSET-026 Tablo 1 ve 2'ye uygunluğu
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, 'No Connection' durumundadır ve SUBSET-026 Tablo 2'de belirtilen geçiş koşulları sağlanmıştır.
test_cases.assumptions: SUBSET-026 Tablo 1 ve 2'deki geçiş kuralları test senaryosuna göre uygulanmıştır.

steps.action: SUBSET-026 Tablo 2'de 'No Connection' dan 'Connection Up' a geçişi sağlayan koşullar sağlanır.
steps.expected: OBU, bağlantı durumunu 'Connection Up' olarak değiştirir ve bu geçiş SUBSET-026 Tablo 1'de tanımlı geçerli bir geçiştir.

test_cases.title: Bağlantı durumunun 'Connection Up' tan 'Connection Lost/Set-Up failed' e geçişinin SUBSET-026 Tablo 1 ve 2'ye uygunluğu
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, 'Connection Up' durumundadır.
test_cases.assumptions: SUBSET-026 Tablo 1 ve 2'deki geçiş kuralları test senaryosuna göre uygulanmıştır.

steps.action: SUBSET-026 Tablo 2'de 'Connection Up' tan 'Connection Lost/Set-Up failed' e geçişi sağlayan koşullar (örneğin zamanlayıcının dolması) sağlanır.
steps.expected: OBU, bağlantı durumunu 'Connection Lost/Set-Up failed' olarak değiştirir ve bu geçiş SUBSET-026 Tablo 1'de tanımlı geçerli bir geçiştir.

test_cases.title: Geçersiz durum geçişlerinin engellenmesi
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, 'No Connection' durumundadır.
test_cases.assumptions: SUBSET-026 Tablo 1'de 'No Connection' dan doğrudan 'Connection Lost/Set-Up failed' e geçiş tanımlı değildir.

steps.action: SUBSET-026 Tablo 1'de tanımlı olmayan bir geçiş koşulu (örneğin 'No Connection' dan doğrudan 'Connection Lost/Set-Up failed' e) simüle edilir.
steps.expected: OBU, bu geçişi yapmaz ve mevcut durumu 'No Connection' olarak korur.

test_cases.title: Birden fazla RIU ile bağlantı varken mevcut infill alanına ait RIU durumunun gösterilmesi
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, birden fazla Radio Infill Unit (RIU) ile güvenli radyo bağlantısı kurmuştur ve araç, belirli bir infill alanındadır.
test_cases.assumptions: Araç konumu, mevcut infill alanını belirlemek için OBU tarafından doğru olarak algılanmaktadır.

steps.action: OBU'nun sürücü arayüzündeki güvenli radyo bağlantı durumu göstergesi gözlemlenir.
steps.expected: Göstergede, aracın bulunduğu mevcut infill alanına ait RIU'nun bağlantı durumu (örneğin 'Connection Up') görünür, diğer RIU'ların durumu değil.

test_cases.title: LRBG geçişinde geçersiz konumun geçerli konumla değiştirilmesi
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, tren konumunun bilinmediği veya geçersiz olduğu bir durumda çalışmaktadır. Araçta daha önce depolanmış geçersiz bir tren konumu bulunmaktadır.
test_cases.test_inputs: LRBG sinyali (Geçerli konum bilgisi içeren).
test_cases.assumptions: LRBG'nin OBU tarafından algılanması ve konum bilgisinin güncellenmesi anlık olarak test edilebilmektedir.

steps.action: Tren, geçerli konum bilgisi içeren bir LRBG üzerinden geçer.

test_cases.title: Interpretation of continuous profile data with incremental distances
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is ready to receive continuous profile data. Previous data state is known (e.g., Value A).
test_cases.test_inputs: Sequence of values: [Value B, Value C, Value D]. Distances: [10m, 20m, 0m (end-of-profile not set)].
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU exposes the interpreted profile values for verification.

steps.action: Transmit continuous profile data with first value B and distance 10m.
steps.expected: The OBU applies the previously received data (Value A) over the first 10m distance.

steps.action: Transmit the next value C and distance 20m.
steps.expected: The OBU applies Value B over the next 20m distance (from 10m to 30m).

steps.action: Transmit the last value D and distance 0m (not end-of-profile).
steps.expected: The OBU applies Value C over the next distance (from 30m to 30m, effectively zero length for C if distance is 0, but the rule says 'each value n applies over the following incremental distance n+1'. Wait, the requirement says 'each value n applies over the following incremental distance n+1'. Let's re-read carefully: 'each value n applies over the following incremental distance n+1'. This implies the distance associated with value n is the distance to the next value. So Value B applies over the distance to Value C. Value C applies over the distance to Value D. Value D applies without limit. The 'previously received data applies over the first distance' means the data before the first received value applies over the distance to the first received value. So: Dist 1 (10m) -> Prev Data. Dist 2 (20m) -> Value B. Dist 3 (0m) -> Value C. Value D applies without limit. Let's adjust the test to reflect this standard interpretation of ETCS profile data where the distance is the length of the segment *before* the next value or the segment *of* the current value? The requirement text: 'each value n applies over the following incremental distance n+1'. This is slightly ambiguous phrasing but usually in ETCS, the distance is the length of the segment for the current value until the next value. Let's assume the standard ETCS interpretation: The distance field indicates the length of the segment for the *current* value. So Value B applies for 10m? No, 'previously received data applies over the first distance'. This implies the first distance is the gap before the first value. So: Distance 1 (10m) is covered by Prev Data. Value B starts at 10m. Distance 2 (20m) is covered by Value B. Value C starts at 30m. Distance 3 (0m) is covered by Value C. Value D starts at 30m. Value D applies without limit. Let's test this.

steps.action: Verify the profile interpretation at distance 5m.
steps.expected: The OBU reports the previously received data (Value A).

steps.action: Verify the profile interpretation at distance 15m.
steps.expected: The OBU reports Value B.

steps.action: Verify the profile interpretation at distance 35m.
steps.expected: The OBU reports Value D (since Value C had 0m length, Value D starts at 30m and applies without limit).

test_cases.title: Interpretation of continuous profile data with end-of-profile value
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is ready to receive continuous profile data.
test_cases.test_inputs: Sequence of values: [Value B, End-of-Profile]. Distances: [10m, 0m].
test_cases.assumptions: End-of-profile value is a specific reserved value defined in SUBSET-026.

steps.action: Transmit continuous profile data with Value B and distance 10m.
steps.expected: The OBU applies previously received data over the first 10m.

steps.action: Transmit the End-of-Profile value and distance 0m.
steps.expected: The OBU applies Value B over the next 0m (effectively ending the profile at 10m). The profile is considered complete.

steps.action: Verify the profile interpretation at distance 15m.
steps.expected: The OBU does not apply Value B or any new value beyond the end-of-profile marker, or reverts to default/previous state as per specific ETCS rules for end-of-profile (usually the last valid value before EOP applies, or the profile ends). The requirement says 'last value applies without limit unless it is the end-of-profile value'. This implies if it IS the end-of-profile value, it does NOT apply without limit. So the profile ends.

test_cases.title: Confidence interval calculation without consist length uncertainty
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in a situation where consist length uncertainty is not applicable (e.g., single unit). Location accuracy of reference BG is 10m. Over-reading amount is 5m. Under-reading amount is 5m.
test_cases.test_inputs: Location accuracy = 10m, Over-reading = 5m, Under-reading = 5m.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU exposes the min safe front end, estimated front end, and max safe front end positions for observation.

steps.action: Evaluate the train front end position confidence interval.
steps.expected: The min safe front end is calculated as Estimated Front End - (Location Accuracy + Under-reading) = Estimated - 15m. The max safe front end is calculated as Estimated Front End + (Location Accuracy + Over-reading) = Estimated + 15m.

test_cases.title: Confidence interval calculation with consist length uncertainty
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in a consist-length-related situation defined in SUBSET-026 §3.6.4.1.5. Location accuracy of reference BG is 10m. Over-reading amount is 5m. Under-reading amount is 5m. Consist length uncertainty is 2m.
test_cases.test_inputs: Location accuracy = 10m, Over-reading = 5m, Under-reading = 5m, Consist length uncertainty = 2m.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU exposes the min safe front end, estimated front end, and max safe front end positions for observation.

steps.action: Evaluate the train front end position confidence interval.
steps.expected: The min safe front end is calculated as Estimated Front End - (Location Accuracy + Under-reading + Consist Length Uncertainty) = Estimated - 17m. The max safe front end is calculated as Estimated Front End + (Location Accuracy + Over-reading + Consist Length Uncertainty) = Estimated + 17m.

test_cases.title: Supervision of roll-away distance using estimated distance travelled

steps.action: Move the train forward by a distance less than the roll-away limit.

steps.action: Continue moving the train forward until the estimated distance travelled equals the roll-away limit.
steps.expected: The remaining distance for roll-away protection reaches zero.

test_cases.title: Supervision of standstill protection using estimated distance travelled

test_cases.title: Supervision of zero distance to former EOA/LOA after Override without valid position
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in a state after Override without valid position. The zero distance to the former EOA/LOA supervision is active.
test_cases.test_inputs: Odometer data simulating movement, including scenarios with under-reading and over-reading.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU interface allows observation of the virtual train front position and the calculated remaining distance. The correction factors for odometer under-/over-reading are known and configured.

steps.action: Move the train forward by a distance D1.
steps.expected: The remaining distance is calculated as (Supervised Distance - D1) corrected by the odometer under-reading factor.

steps.action: Move the train forward by an additional distance D2, simulating odometer over-reading.
steps.expected: The remaining distance is calculated as (Supervised Distance - (D1+D2)) corrected by the odometer over-reading factor.

test_cases.title: Supervision of Staff Responsible distance using virtual train front position
test_cases.preconditions: Staff Responsible distance supervision is active. The OBU is deriving the virtual train front position.
test_cases.test_inputs: Odometer data simulating movement, including scenarios with under-reading and over-reading.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU interface allows observation of the virtual train front position and the calculated remaining distance. The correction factors for odometer under-/over-reading are known and configured.

steps.action: Move the train forward by a distance D1.
steps.expected: The remaining distance is calculated as (Staff Responsible Max Distance - D1) corrected by the odometer under-reading factor, using the estimated, max safe and min safe front ends.

steps.action: Move the train forward by an additional distance D2, simulating odometer over-reading.
steps.expected: The remaining distance is calculated as (Staff Responsible Max Distance - (D1+D2)) corrected by the odometer over-reading factor, using the estimated, max safe and min safe front ends.

steps.expected: The stored information is completely replaced by the new track description from L0 to L4.

test_cases.title: MA request includes all applicable reasons
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2 and connected to RBC. Multiple MA request conditions are active simultaneously (e.g., Section timer expired and track description deletion).

steps.action: Trigger a condition that results in a single MA request reason (e.g., Section timer expiry).
steps.expected: OBU sends an MA request to the RBC. The message contains only that specific reason.

steps.action: Trigger a second condition that results in a different MA request reason while the first condition is still relevant or just before the next request.
steps.expected: OBU sends an MA request to the RBC. The message contains both applicable reasons.

test_cases.title: MA request triggered by perturbation-location criterion
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2. The train is moving. The perturbation-location criterion is configured and active.

steps.expected: No MA request is sent to the RBC.

steps.action: Move the train front so that it passes the calculated perturbation location.
steps.expected: OBU triggers and sends an MA request to the RBC.

steps.action: Receive a track description deletion message from the RBC corresponding to situation 'a' (or b, f, or k).
steps.expected: OBU does NOT send an MA request to the RBC.

test_cases.title: End Section timer start upon passing start location
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Full Supervision mode. A Movement Authority (MA) containing an End Section timer start location and a non-zero timeout value is received from trackside. The train is moving towards the start location.
test_cases.test_inputs: MA with End Section timer start location at 1000m from current position, timeout value 30s.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU's max safe front end is calculated correctly based on current speed and braking curve.

steps.action: Move the train such that the max safe front end is just before the End Section timer start location (e.g., 999m).
steps.expected: The End Section timer is not started (timer value is 0 or inactive).

steps.action: Continue moving the train such that the max safe front end passes the End Section timer start location (e.g., 1001m).
steps.expected: The End Section timer starts counting down from the received timeout value (30s).

test_cases.title: End Section timer timeout consequences
test_cases.preconditions: The End Section timer is running. The current MA includes location-based information (e.g., speed limits) and a non-zero target speed at the End of Movement Authority (EOA).
test_cases.test_inputs: End Section timer timeout value set to 5s for testability. Current train position is 500m from EOA.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU can simulate or wait for the timer to expire.

steps.action: Allow the End Section timer to exceed the timeout value.
steps.expected: The OBU withdraws the EOA/LOA to the train's current position (500m). The location-based information listed in SUBSET-026 Appendix A.3.4 is deleted. The target speed at the new EOA (current position) is set to zero.

test_cases.title: LOA speed timer start in Level 2
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is operating in Level 2. A new MA message is received from trackside.
test_cases.test_inputs: MA message with timestamp T0. LOA speed timer timeout value is 10s.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU clock is synchronized with the trackside message timestamp.

steps.action: Receive the MA message at time T0.
steps.expected: The LOA speed timer starts at the timestamp T0 of the message.

test_cases.title: LOA speed timer start in Level 1

test_cases.test_inputs: Balise group with MA information. LOA speed timer timeout value is 10s.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU correctly identifies the first balise of the group.

steps.action: Pass the first encountered balise of the balise group giving the MA.
steps.expected: The LOA speed timer starts at the moment of passing the first balise.

test_cases.title: LOA speed timer timeout consequences
test_cases.preconditions: The LOA speed timer is running. The current MA includes a LOA with a non-zero speed and location-based information.
test_cases.test_inputs: LOA speed timer timeout value set to 5s. LOA speed is 100 km/h.

steps.action: Allow the LOA speed timer to exceed the timeout value.
steps.expected: The speed associated with the LOA is set to zero. The LOA becomes an EOA. The Supervised Location (SvL) is defined per SUBSET-026 §3.8.4.5. The location-based information listed in SUBSET-026 Appendix A.3.4 is deleted.

test_cases.title: Overlap timer start upon passing start location

test_cases.test_inputs: MA with Overlap timer start location at 2000m from current position, timeout value 60s.

steps.expected: The Overlap timer starts counting down from the received timeout value (60s).

test_cases.title: Overlap timer start with infinite timeout
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Full Supervision mode. A MA containing an Overlap timer start location and a timeout value of 'infinite' is received. The train is moving towards the start location.
test_cases.test_inputs: MA with Overlap timer start location at 2000m, timeout value 'infinite'.

steps.expected: The Overlap timer is regarded as started (active state), even though the timeout value is 'infinite'.

test_cases.title: Overlap timer timeout consequences
test_cases.preconditions: The Overlap timer is running. The current MA includes an overlap with a release speed and location-based information. The EOA has a non-zero target speed.
test_cases.test_inputs: Overlap timer timeout value set to 5s. Overlap release speed is 50 km/h.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU can simulate or wait for the timer to expire.

steps.action: Allow the Overlap timer to exceed the timeout value.
steps.expected: The overlap and its associated release speed are deleted. The Supervised Location is redetermined per SUBSET-026 §3.8.4.5. Location-based information per Appendix A.3.4 is deleted. The target speed at the End of Movement Authority is set to zero.

test_cases.title: Overlap timer expiration upon train standstill
test_cases.preconditions: The Overlap timer has been started and is running. The train is moving.
test_cases.test_inputs: Overlap timer timeout value 60s. Train speed reduced to 0 km/h.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU detects standstill when speed is 0 for a defined period (e.g., 1s).

steps.action: Bring the train to a complete standstill while the Overlap timer is running.
steps.expected: The OBU treats the Overlap timer as expired. The consequences defined for Overlap time-out in SUBSET-026 §3.8.4.4.2 are applied (overlap deleted, SvL redetermined, EOA speed set to zero).

test_cases.title: Overlap timer timeout upon receiving new MA with rear start location
test_cases.preconditions: No Overlap timer is currently running. The OBU's max safe front end is at position 1500m. A new MA is received with an Overlap timer start location at 1000m (rear of max safe front end).
test_cases.test_inputs: New MA with Overlap timer start location at 1000m.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU correctly compares the start location with the max safe front end position.

steps.action: Receive the new MA with the Overlap timer start location in rear of the max safe front end.
steps.expected: The OBU considers the Overlap timer as having exceeded its time-out value. The consequences defined in SUBSET-026 §3.8.4.4.2 are applied.

test_cases.title: Supervised Location determination with active overlap
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU has an active overlap that has not timed out. A Danger Point and an End Section are also defined in the MA.
test_cases.test_inputs: Overlap end at 2000m, Danger Point at 2500m, End Section end at 3000m.
test_cases.assumptions: The overlap is valid and not expired.

steps.action: Query the OBU for the current Supervised Location.
steps.expected: The Supervised Location is set to the end of the overlap (2000m).

test_cases.title: Supervised Location determination with no overlap but Danger Point

test_cases.test_inputs: Danger Point at 2500m, End Section end at 3000m.
test_cases.assumptions: The overlap is not present or has expired.

steps.action: Query the OBU for the current Supervised Location.
steps.expected: The Supervised Location is set to the Danger Point (2500m).

test_cases.title: Supervised Location determination with no overlap or Danger Point
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU has no active overlap and no Danger Point defined in the MA. An End Section is defined.
test_cases.test_inputs: End Section end at 3000m.
test_cases.assumptions: No overlap or Danger Point is present.

steps.action: Query the OBU for the current Supervised Location.
steps.expected: The Supervised Location is set to the end of the End Section (3000m).

test_cases.title: Infill MA evaluation in Full Supervision
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Full Supervision mode. An infill MA is received.

test_cases.assumptions: The infill MA is correctly formatted.

steps.action: Receive the infill MA while in Full Supervision mode.
steps.expected: The OBU evaluates the infill MA and updates the movement authority accordingly.

test_cases.title: Infill MA evaluation with available linking information
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Full Supervision mode. Linking information for the main signal balise group is available. An infill MA referring to that balise group is received.

test_cases.title: Replacement of previous MA data upon receiving a new MA from RBC
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is currently supervising a valid MA (MA_old) with specific speed limits and location data.
test_cases.test_inputs: A new MA (MA_new) is transmitted by the RBC. MA_new contains different speed limits and location data than MA_old.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU is in a state where it can accept new MA data (e.g., not in a critical failure state).

steps.action: Transmit a new MA (MA_new) from the RBC to the OBU.
steps.expected: The OBU receives the new MA.

steps.action: Check the OBU's internal MA data storage.
steps.expected: All data of the previous MA (MA_old) has been replaced by the data of the new MA (MA_new). No residual data from MA_old remains.

test_cases.title: Replacement of previous MA data upon receiving a new MA from a main-signal balise group
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is currently supervising a valid MA (MA_old). The train is approaching a main signal with a balise group.
test_cases.test_inputs: A new MA (MA_new) is read from a main-signal balise group (non-infill information). MA_new contains different data than MA_old.
test_cases.assumptions: The balise group is correctly identified as a main-signal balise group and not an infill group.

steps.action: Pass the main-signal balise group containing the new MA (MA_new).
steps.expected: The OBU reads the new MA from the balise group.

steps.action: Check the OBU's internal MA data storage.
steps.expected: All data of the previous MA (MA_old) has been replaced by the data of the new MA (MA_new).

test_cases.title: Partial replacement of MA data upon receiving infill information
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is currently supervising a valid MA (MA_old) that extends beyond the next main signal. The next main signal has a balise group.
test_cases.test_inputs: An infill MA (MA_infill) is received. MA_infill contains data for the section beyond the announced balise group at the next main signal.
test_cases.assumptions: The infill MA is correctly identified as infill information.

steps.action: Receive the infill MA (MA_infill).
steps.expected: The OBU processes the infill MA.

steps.action: Check the OBU's internal MA data storage for the section up to the next main signal.
steps.expected: The data for the section up to the next main signal remains unchanged from MA_old.

steps.action: Check the OBU's internal MA data storage for the section beyond the next main signal.
steps.expected: The data for the section beyond the next main signal is replaced by the data from MA_infill.

test_cases.title: Start of new MA section at infill location reference
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is supervising an MA. The next main signal has a balise group at a specific location reference (L_ref).

test_cases.assumptions: The infill MA is associated with the balise group at the next main signal.

steps.action: Receive the infill MA.
steps.expected: The OBU processes the infill MA.

steps.action: Check the OBU's MA section definition.
steps.expected: A new MA section starts at the infill location reference, which is the balise group at the next main signal (L_ref).

test_cases.title: Treatment of new MA with SvL as MA shortening while supervising LOA

test_cases.assumptions: The new MA is valid and correctly formatted.

steps.action: Check the stored location based information.

test_cases.title: Adopt shortened MA when train is rear of Indication supervision limit
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in a mode where MA is active. The current MA has a defined Indication supervision limit. The train front end position is known to be rear of the proposed shortened MA's Indication supervision limit.
test_cases.test_inputs: RBC request to shorten MA with new MA data, mode profile, and SH-area balise group list.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU can simulate or receive a valid RBC request for MA shortening. The train position is set such that the front end is rear of the new Indication supervision limit.

steps.action: Send an RBC request to shorten the MA to a new value where the train front end is rear of the new Indication supervision limit.
steps.expected: The OBU adopts the proposed shortened MA, including its mode profile and SH-area balise group list.

steps.action: Check the communication log or status message sent to the RBC.
steps.expected: The OBU informs the RBC that it has adopted the new MA.

test_cases.title: Reject shortened MA when train is not rear of Indication supervision limit
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in a mode where MA is active. The current MA has a defined Indication supervision limit. The train front end position is known to be at or ahead of the proposed shortened MA's Indication supervision limit.
test_cases.test_inputs: RBC request to shorten MA with new MA data, mode profile, and SH-area balise group list.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU can simulate or receive a valid RBC request for MA shortening. The train position is set such that the front end is not rear of the new Indication supervision limit.

steps.action: Send an RBC request to shorten the MA to a new value where the train front end is not rear of the new Indication supervision limit.
steps.expected: The OBU rejects the request and keeps the previous MA, mode profile, and SH-area balise group list.

steps.action: Check the communication log or status message sent to the RBC.
steps.expected: The OBU informs the RBC that it has rejected the new MA.

test_cases.title: Boundary condition: Train front end exactly at Indication supervision limit
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in a mode where MA is active. The train front end position is set exactly at the proposed shortened MA's Indication supervision limit.
test_cases.test_inputs: RBC request to shorten MA with new MA data, mode profile, and SH-area balise group list.
test_cases.assumptions: The requirement states 'rear of' the limit. Being exactly at the limit is not 'rear of'. Therefore, the OBU should reject the request.

steps.action: Send an RBC request to shorten the MA to a new value where the train front end is exactly at the new Indication supervision limit.
steps.expected: The OBU rejects the request and keeps the previous MA, mode profile, and SH-area balise group list.

steps.action: Check the communication log or status message sent to the RBC.
steps.expected: The OBU informs the RBC that it has rejected the new MA.

test_cases.title: OBU'nun desteklemediği infill ortamı talebinin yok sayılması

test_cases.title: OBU reads next main signal balise group and ignores subsequent infill

steps.action: Transmit the next main signal balise group data to the OBU.

steps.action: Transmit additional infill information from the loop to the OBU.

test_cases.title: OBU detects missed next main signal balise group and ignores subsequent infill

steps.action: Transmit infill information from the loop to the OBU.

steps.action: Simulate the condition where the next main signal balise group is missed (e.g., by not transmitting it and allowing the detection timeout to expire).
steps.expected: OBU detects that the next main signal balise group was missed.

steps.action: Transmit additional infill information from the loop to the OBU.
steps.expected: OBU ignores the additional infill information and does not update its state based on it.

test_cases.title: Emergency stop active: New movement authority is rejected
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in a state where it has accepted an emergency stop message and the emergency stop has not yet been revoked.
test_cases.test_inputs: A valid new movement authority (MA) message.

steps.action: Send a new movement authority message to the OBU.
steps.expected: The OBU rejects the new movement authority.

steps.action: Check the OBU status regarding the active movement authority.
steps.expected: The OBU does not apply the new movement authority and maintains the emergency stop state.

test_cases.title: Emergency stop revoked: New movement authority is accepted
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU has accepted an emergency stop message. The emergency stop is subsequently revoked.
test_cases.test_inputs: A valid new movement authority (MA) message sent after the revocation.

steps.action: Send a revocation message for the emergency stop to the OBU.
steps.expected: The OBU accepts the revocation and clears the emergency stop state.

steps.action: Send a new movement authority message to the OBU.
steps.expected: The OBU accepts the new movement authority.

test_cases.title: Emergency stop active: Invalid movement authority is rejected
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in a state where it has accepted an emergency stop message and the emergency stop has not yet been revoked.
test_cases.test_inputs: An invalid or malformed movement authority message.

steps.action: Send an invalid movement authority message to the OBU.
steps.expected: The OBU rejects the message.

steps.action: Verify the OBU state.
steps.expected: The OBU remains in the emergency stop state and does not apply any movement authority.

test_cases.title: Emergency message revocation acknowledgement
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in operational mode and has previously received and acknowledged an emergency message. The RBC is configured to send a revocation for this specific emergency message.
test_cases.test_inputs: Emergency Message Revocation message from RBC.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU is connected to the RBC via a valid GSM-R or ETCS link. The specific emergency message ID is known to the OBU.

steps.action: Send an Emergency Message Revocation message from the RBC to the OBU containing the ID of the previously acknowledged emergency message.
steps.expected: The OBU receives the revocation message and processes it according to SUBSET-026 §3.16.3.5.

steps.action: Monitor the OBU's response to the RBC.
steps.expected: The OBU sends an acknowledgement message to the RBC confirming the receipt and processing of the revocation.

steps.action: Check the OBU's internal state regarding the emergency message.
steps.expected: The emergency message is no longer active or displayed as an active alert in the OBU's internal state.

test_cases.title: On-Sight modunda ray kenarı hız limitinin ulusal ve varsayılan değerlere önceliği

test_cases.title: Ray kenarı hız limitinin ulusal ve varsayılan değerlerden yüksek olması durumu
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, On-Sight modundadır. Ulusal hız limiti 50 km/s, varsayılan hız limiti 60 km/s olarak yapılandırılmıştır.

test_cases.title: Ray kenarı hız limitinin sıfır olması durumu

test_cases.title: PBD verisi alındığında hız kısıtlamasının hesaplanması
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, ray kenarı (trackside) ile iletişim halindedir ve geçerli bir PBD (Permitted Braking Distance) verisi seti mevcuttur.
test_cases.test_inputs: Geçerli PBD verisi (SUBSET-026 §3.11.11'e uygun).
test_cases.assumptions: OBU'nun iç saat ve sensör verileri stabil ve tutarlıdır.

steps.action: Ray kenarından geçerli bir PBD verisi seti gönderilir.
steps.expected: OBU, gelen veriyi işler ve PBD'yi sağlamak için gerekli hız kısıtlamasını hesaplar.

steps.action: Hesaplanan hız kısıtlaması değeri gözlemlenir.
steps.expected: Hesaplanan hız kısıtlaması, SUBSET-026 §3.11.11.4'te belirtilen varsayımlara göre tutarlı bir değerdir ve OBU bu değeri uygulayacak duruma geçer.

test_cases.title: Girdi değişmediğinde yeniden hesaplamanın yapılmaması
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, PBD verisi alarak bir hız kısıtlaması hesaplamıştır ve sistem stabil bir durumdadır.
test_cases.test_inputs: Değişmeyen PBD girdi seti.
test_cases.assumptions: Hesaplama için kullanılan diğer girdiler (hız, eğim vb.) sabit tutulur.

steps.action: Hesaplama için kullanılan girdilerden hiçbiri değişmeden, aynı PBD verisi seti tekrar işlenir veya sistem bekletilir.
steps.expected: OBU, hız kısıtlamasını yeniden hesaplamaz (hesaplama işlemi tetiklenmez).

steps.action: Mevcut hız kısıtlaması değeri kontrol edilir.
steps.expected: Hız kısıtlaması değeri, önceki hesaplamayla aynı kalır.

test_cases.title: Girdi değiştiğinde yeniden hesaplamanın yapılması
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, PBD verisi alarak bir hız kısıtlaması hesaplamıştır.
test_cases.test_inputs: Değiştirilmiş PBD verisi veya ilgili girdi (örneğin eğim veya frenleme parametresi).
test_cases.assumptions: Değişen girdi, SUBSET-026 §3.11.11'de tanımlanan hesaplama girdileri arasındadır.

steps.action: Hesaplama için kullanılan girdilerden biri (örneğin PBD mesafesi veya eğim) değiştirilir.
steps.expected: OBU, girdi değişikliğini algılar ve hız kısıtlamasını yeniden hesaplamayı tetikler.

steps.action: Yeni hesaplanan hız kısıtlaması değeri gözlemlenir.
steps.expected: Hız kısıtlaması, yeni girdi değerlerine göre güncellenmiş ve farklı bir değer alır.

test_cases.title: Hesaplama varsayımlarının (EBD/SBD, sıfır ivme, sabit gecikme) uygulanması
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, PBD hesaplama modundadır ve SUBSET-026 §3.11.11.4 varsayımları etkinleştirilmiştir.
test_cases.test_inputs: Bilinen PBD mesafesi ve araç parametreleri.
test_cases.assumptions: Hesaplama motoru, dönen kütle telafili eğimi, güvenli frenleme varsayımlarını ve sabit hız hatası/geri besleme gecikmesini kullanmaktadır.

steps.action: Belirli bir PBD mesafesi ve araç durumu için hız kısıtlaması hesaplaması yapılır.
steps.expected: Hesaplama, EBD eğrisinin (ve hizmet freni PBD için SBD eğrisinin) izin verilen frenleme mesafesinde sıfır hıza ulaştığı varsayımını kullanır.

steps.action: Hesaplama çıktısı, bağımsız bir referans modelle (SUBSET-026 §3.11.11.4'e göre) karşılaştırılır.
steps.expected: OBU'nun hesapladığı hız kısıtlaması, sıfır tahmini ivme ve sabit işleme/frenleme gecikme varsayımlarını içeren referans modelle eşleşir.

test_cases.title: Acil fren (EBD) tabanlı PBD hız kısıtlamasının hesaplanması
test_cases.preconditions: Ray kenarı, PBD'nin acil fren (EBD) kullanılarak sağlanmasını gerektirmektedir.
test_cases.test_inputs: EBD tabanlı PBD verisi.
test_cases.assumptions: SUBSET-026 §3.11.11.6'daki eşitsizlikler ve yuvarlatma kuralları bilinmektedir.

steps.action: EBD tabanlı PBD verisi OBU'ya gönderilir.
steps.expected: OBU, SUBSET-026 §3.11.11.6'daki EBD tabanlı eşitsizlikleri sağlayan hızı hesaplar.

steps.action: Hesaplanan hız değeri kontrol edilir.
steps.expected: Hız değeri, eşitsizlikleri sağlayan en yüksek hızdır ve SUBSET-026 §3.11.11.6'da belirtildiği gibi aşağı yuvarlatılmıştır.

test_cases.title: Hiçbir hızın eşitsizlikleri sağlamadığında hızın sıfır olması
test_cases.preconditions: Ray kenarı, PBD'nin acil fren (EBD) kullanılarak sağlanmasını gerektirmektedir.
test_cases.test_inputs: Çok kısa PBD mesafesi veya yüksek başlangıç hızı gibi, EBD tabanlı eşitsizlikleri hiçbir pozitif hızın sağlayamayacağı bir senaryo.
test_cases.assumptions: Girdi verileri, fiziksel olarak frenlemenin imkansız olduğu veya mevcut hızın çok yüksek olduğu bir durumu temsil etmektedir.

steps.action: EBD tabanlı eşitsizlikleri hiçbir pozitif hızın sağlayamayacağı PBD verisi OBU'ya gönderilir.
steps.expected: OBU, hesaplama yapar ve eşitsizlikleri sağlayan bir hız bulunamadığını belirler.

steps.action: Hesaplanan PBD hız kısıtlaması değeri gözlemlenir.
steps.expected: Hız kısıtlaması değeri 0 (sıfır) olarak ayarlanır.

test_cases.title: Tunnel stopping area start evaluation with estimated front end
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in operational mode. A tunnel stopping area is defined in the track database. The train is approaching the tunnel stopping area.
test_cases.test_inputs: Train position data such that the estimated front end is just before the start of the tunnel stopping area.
test_cases.assumptions: The estimated front end position is calculated correctly by the OBU based on train length and current position.

steps.action: Move the train so that the estimated front end is 10 meters before the start of the tunnel stopping area.
steps.expected: The OBU does not trigger the tunnel stopping area condition.

steps.action: Move the train so that the estimated front end is exactly at the start of the tunnel stopping area.
steps.expected: The OBU evaluates the start of the tunnel stopping area as active.

steps.action: Move the train so that the estimated front end is 10 meters inside the tunnel stopping area.
steps.expected: The OBU continues to evaluate the tunnel stopping area as active.

test_cases.title: Tunnel stopping area end evaluation with estimated front end
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in operational mode. The train is currently inside a tunnel stopping area.
test_cases.test_inputs: Train position data such that the estimated front end is approaching the end of the tunnel stopping area.
test_cases.assumptions: The estimated front end position is calculated correctly by the OBU based on train length and current position.

steps.action: Move the train so that the estimated front end is 10 meters before the end of the tunnel stopping area.
steps.expected: The OBU continues to evaluate the tunnel stopping area as active.

steps.action: Move the train so that the estimated front end is exactly at the end of the tunnel stopping area.
steps.expected: The OBU evaluates the end of the tunnel stopping area, deactivating the condition.

steps.action: Move the train so that the estimated front end is 10 meters after the end of the tunnel stopping area.
steps.expected: The OBU does not evaluate the tunnel stopping area as active.

test_cases.title: Sound horn track condition start evaluation with estimated front end
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in operational mode. A sound horn track condition is defined in the track database. The train is approaching the sound horn track condition.

test_cases.assumptions: The estimated front end position is calculated correctly by the OBU based on train length and current position.
